papers.title: A multidisciplinary, staged, and minimally invasive surgical approach for aortoesophageal fistula caused by ingested fish bone: a case report
papers.authors: Chen, Zhen; Zhang, Qiang; Liu, Qiuxia; Chen, Hao; Chen, Pengfei
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction and importance Aortoesophageal fistula (AEF) caused by an esophageal foreign body (EFB) is a life-threatening condition with extremely high mortality. There is no consensus on optimal management. This report illustrates a multidisciplinary, staged, and minimally invasive strategy that may improve outcomes in EFB-induced AEF. Case presentation A 70-year-old male presented with hematemesis 5 h after intermittent chest discomfort over two weeks following fish bone ingestion. Diagnosis was confirmed by chest CT, esophagogastroduodenoscopy, and aortography. Emergency thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR) was performed to control bleeding. This was followed by a combined thoracoscopic-laparoscopic procedure to resect the affected esophagus, debride the mediastinum, wrap the aortic fistula with omentum, and reconstruct the digestive tract. The patient recovered well and has remained alive and well with no recurrent symptoms during 10 months of follow-up. Clinical discussion This case demonstrates the efficacy of a staged approach integrating endovascular and minimally invasive surgical techniques. TEVAR provides immediate hemorrhage control as a bridge, while subsequent thoracoscopic-laparoscopic surgery addresses esophageal injury and prevents graft infection through omental wrapping. The strategy may reduce the high mortality associated with traditional open repair, particularly in elderly patients with comorbidities. Conclusion A multidisciplinary, staged, and minimally invasive approach combining TEVAR with thoracoscopic-laparoscopic esophageal resection and reconstruction may be a feasible treatment option for selected patients with EFB-induced AEF. Larger studies and longer follow-up are needed to validate its safety and durability.
papers.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了一例因误吞鱼骨导致食管异物（EFB）并发主动脉食管瘘（AEF）的70岁男性患者，采用多学科、分期、微创策略进行治疗。急诊先行胸主动脉腔内修复术（TEVAR）控制出血，随后行胸腔镜-腹腔镜联合手术切除受累食管、纵隔清创、带蒂大网膜包裹主动脉瘘口并重建消化道。患者术后恢复良好，随访10个月无复发。该策略对合并基础疾病的老年EFB所致AEF患者可能降低传统开放手术的高死亡率，但需更大样本和更长随访验证。

papers.title: Modelling the financial viability of offshore aquaculture using a case study of a sea bass farm in the Bay of Lion, France
papers.authors: Van Dyken, Jeremy; Habibniya, Houshang; Dsouza, Suzan; Sclodnick, Tyler
papers.journal: Journal of Ocean and Coastal Economics
papers.abstract: The extension of net pen aquaculture to open ocean sites provides many advantages to the industry including opportunity for expansion, utilization of high energy sites, and better resilience to certain near shore or surface-associated stressors. The industry has been slow to develop due to high perceived risks and a lack of operating farms to provide financial information for open ocean farm operations. A model was developed to evaluate the economic viability of a hypothetical sea bass aquaculture venture in the open French Mediterranean Sea that utilizes open ocean submersible farming systems. Advanced open ocean equipment, including submersible net pens, environmental sensors, and camera systems with artificial intelligence can boost farm throughput, decrease personnel costs, reduce feed wastage, and reduce stress from hypoxia events or algal blooms. A spatial analysis considering bathymetry, wave height, current velocity, maritime traffic, and shoreline proximity was used to select an optimal location leading to more realistic financial inputs. The model projects the operation to generate 5,220 tonnes of sea bass per annum (live weight equivalent) and an internal rate of return of 19.43%. An investment of $39,924,456 is required and leads to an aggregate net present value (NPV) of $166,058,739. The model indicates that open ocean aquaculture can provide investment competitive financial returns and offers important insights into the economics of open ocean farming given the unavailability of commercial examples.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究构建经济模型评估法国地中海利翁湾离岸海鲈养殖场的财务可行性，通过整合水深、波高、流速、航运及岸线距离等空间分析选定最优场址，并纳入可潜式网箱、环境传感器及AI摄像系统等先进装备。模型预测年产量5,220吨（活重），内部收益率19.43%，需投资3,992万美元，净现值达1.66亿美元。结果表明离岸 aquaculture 可提供具投资竞争力的财务回报，为缺乏商业运营案例的 open ocean farming 经济性提供了重要参考。

papers.title: Comparative antibacterial activity of Cymbopogon citratus and Cymbopogon winterianus essential oils against Vibrio parahaemolyticus in shrimp aquaculture
papers.authors: dos Santos Filho, Luiz G. A.; dos Reis, Renata B.; Souza, Ana Sheila Q.; Canuto, Kirley M.; Ribeiro, Paulo Riceli V.; Castro, Karina N. C.; Diniz, Fábio Mendonça; Pereira, Alitiene M. L.
papers.journal: Journal of Biologically Active Products from Nature
papers.summary_cn: 比较柠檬草（Cymbopogon citratus）与爪哇香茅（Cymbopogon winterianus）精油对虾类养殖中副溶血性弧菌（Vibrio parahaemolyticus）的抗菌活性，旨在筛选替代抗生素的天然抗菌剂。
该文为对湖鲟（Acipenser fulvescens）基于成鱼 capture–mark–recapture 数据估算生长与寿命研究的更正说明，无摘要，内容不涉及新的研究数据或结论。

papers.authors: Haddock, Janey B.; Rodríguez‐Jiménez, Edna Karina; Beristain‐Cardoso, Ricardo; González‐Blanco, Gehovana; Manjarrez‐Silva, Javier; Ruiz‐Gómez, María de Lourdes
papers.abstract: Abstract Nitrate pollution is one of the most widespread forms of contamination, and in high concentrations has adverse effects on aquatic ecosystems. Fish are susceptible to this contaminant and are known to modify their behaviour in a variety of ways when exposed, but most information regarding changes in behaviour pertains only to long‐term or chronic exposure. Therefore, this study aimed to use zebrafish ( Danio rerio ) as a model fish species to create a specialized ethogram relevant to acute nitrate contamination and identify any immediate changes in behaviour (within the initial 10 min of exposure). Three water treatments were created in a laboratory setting: water with optimum conditions to support D. rerio , and water with two levels of nitrate concentration: 11 mg/L NO 3 − ‐N and 100 mg/L NO 3 − ‐N. Fish were filmed in each treatment group, and visual review of the footage identified nine unique behaviours. These behaviours were measured in frequency, duration and latency per fish, and the values were compared between treatments. From those, repetitive long movement, repetitive short movement and freezing increased in occurrences in conjunction with sweeping decreasing in occurrence when fish were exposed to higher concentrations of nitrates. The findings suggest that four behaviours (repetitive long movement, repetitive short movement, freezing and sweeping), which immediately change in the presence of high concentrations, may be relevant in indicating exposure to acute nitrate contamination.
papers.summary_cn: 以斑马鱼（Danio rerio）为模型，构建适用于急性硝酸盐污染的专属行为谱，并检测暴露最初10 min内的即时行为变化。实验设置对照、11 mg/L NO₃⁻-N和100 mg/L NO₃⁻-N三组，通过录像分析9种行为的频率、时长和潜伏期。结果显示，高浓度硝酸盐暴露下重复性长距离运动、重复性短距离运动和 freezing 频率增加，sweeping 减少，提示这4种行为可作为急性硝酸盐污染的指示指标。

papers.title: Contrasting Effects of Chitosan Molecular Modifications on the Properties of Fish Gelatin Hydrogels
papers.authors: Nikiforova, Alena A.; Abramov, Vladislav; Skvortsova, Polina V.; Akhmadiyarov, Aydar A.; Rakipov, Ilnaz T.; Sorokin, Andrey V.; Lavlinskaya, Maria S.; Zueva, Olga S.; Holyavka, Marina G.; Derkach, Svetlana R.
papers.abstract: The limited water solubility of chitosan, which necessitates acidic conditions for its dissolution, restricts its application in food and pharmaceutical systems. To overcome this limitation, we chemically modified a chitosan molecule by introducing hydrophilic groups and compared three chitosan forms—unmodified chitosan, its quaternary ammonium derivative, and a graft copolymer with poly-N-vinylpyrrolidone, with respect to their effect on the structural and mechanical properties of fish gelatin hydrogels. An experimental study combining NMR relaxometry and water self-diffusion measurements, scanning electron microscopy, and rheology revealed a distinct supramolecular architecture of gelatin–chitosan hydrogel network for different chitosan modifications. The NMR data gave information on the molecular mobility of water as a marker of hydrogel structure to elucidate molecular basis for the observed rheological properties. Unmodified chitosan maximally reinforces gelatin network and enhances its thermorheological stability. Chitosan grafting with poly-N-vinylpyrrolidone produces a fine-pored xerogel structure with higher thermorheological stability, possibly through a non-cooperative reinforcement mechanism. The quaternary ammonium derivative results in a heterogeneous xerogel morphology with weak mechanical strength and low gel–sol transition temperature. These findings establish the structure–property correlation, demonstrating that chitosan modification governs the molecular network architecture and macroscopic performance of gelatin-based hydrogels, providing molecular-level insights into the behavior of fish gelatin–chitosan systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过引入亲水基团对壳聚糖进行化学改性，比较了未改性壳聚糖、季铵盐衍生物及聚-N-乙烯基吡咯烷酮接枝共聚物对鱼明胶水凝胶结构与力学性能的影响。结合NMR弛豫测量、水自扩散测定、扫描电镜和流变学分析，揭示了不同壳聚糖改性下明胶-壳聚糖水凝胶网络的不同超分子结构。未改性壳聚糖最大程度增强明胶网络并提升其热流变稳定性；接枝共聚物形成细孔干凝胶结构且热流变稳定性较高；季铵盐衍生物则导致非均质干凝胶形态、力学强度弱且凝胶-溶胶转变温度低。

papers.title: Combined deodorization of dry protein products from secondary fish raw materials
papers.authors: Arabova, Z. M.; Nugmanov, A. Kh-Kh.; Aleksanyan, I. Yu.; Odintsova, A. I.; Osmolovsky, P. D.; Fomenko, E. V.
papers.abstract: Introduction. The fish processing industry annually produces a significant amount of secondary raw materials – caviar and roe complex, liver, and other organs of ordinary fish species. This raw material is a promising source for obtaining valuable food ingredients, including fractionated lecithin and isolated protein products. However, their widespread use is limited by the presence of a persistent fishy odor, which significantly reduces the organoleptic properties and consumer appeal of the final product. The goal of the research was to investigate the mechanisms of formation of volatile compounds responsible for the undesirable odor in dried catfish liver and raffinate after the extraction of lecithin-containing substances from fish roe, as well as to develop an effective and cost-effective deodorization method. The objects and methods of the research were dried catfish liver and raffinate after lecithin extraction. The paper provides a comparative analysis of physicochemical deodorization methods, including treatment with organic acids and natural antioxidants. Volatile compound concentrations were determined using gas chromatographymass spectrometry. The results and discussion. The research confirmed that the main sources of undesirable odors were three groups of volatile compounds: nitrogenous (trimethylamine, ammonia), carbonyl (hexanal, nonanal), and sulfur-containing (dimethyl sulfide, methyl mercaptan). A comparative analysis substantiated the effectiveness of combined treatment with organic acids and natural antioxidants. Experiments confirmed that a combination of 1% citric acid and 0.3% rosemary extract reduced trimethylamine content by 70%, hexanal by 45%, and improved organoleptic properties by 3 points. Conclusion. The proposed method is technologically feasible, does not require significant capital investment, and can be recommended for the implementation in the food industry. It opens up prospects for expanding the use of secondary protein products in the production of food ingredients with improved organoleptic properties.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在探究鲶鱼肝脏干制品及鱼卵卵磷脂提取后残液中不良腥味挥发性化合物的形成机制，并开发高效经济的脱臭方法。通过GC-MS分析确认主要异味来源为含氮类（三甲胺、氨）、羰基类（己醛、壬醛）和含硫类（二甲基硫醚、甲硫醇）化合物。结果表明，1%柠檬酸与0.3%迷迭香提取物联合处理可使三甲胺降低70%、己醛降低45%，感官评分提升3分，该方法工艺可行且无需大量资本投入。

papers.title: Development of Rice-Fish Farming in Enhancing Economic and Seasonal Benefits: A Case Study from Bangladesh
papers.authors: Tabassum, Tahmina; Bashar, Abul; Haque, Mohammad Mahfujul; Alam, Md. Mehedi; Rahman, Md Yeaminur; Hasan, Neaz A.
papers.abstract: Integrated rice-fish farming can enhance the efficiency of land use, diversify production with varied foods, and support smallholder income security. However, pathways to adoption, economic viability, and seasonal advantages related to integrated rice-fish farming need more documentation in northwest Bangladesh. To fill this knowledge gap, this exploratory study investigated the process of adoption, farm attributes, comparative productivity, and seasonal livelihood benefits of integrated rice-fish farming among selected farmers in the Dinajpur Sadar subdistrict. This study analyzed the data collected from 30 rice-fish farms that also had rice-only fields, making comparison possible between rice-fish and rice-only agriculture. Several participatory rural appraisal techniques, such as historical timeline analysis, transects, focus group discussion, and questionnaire survey, were used to collect the data. The majority of rice-fish farmers were young and educated farmers practicing in medium lowland irrigated rice farming systems. Commonly cultured fish species were carps and Tilapia, stocked at a density of 24,700 ± 3250 individual ha−1. While rice production did not vary significantly between rice-fish and rice-only field practices, additional fish production raised gross income, net income, and benefit-cost ratio. Gross income in rice-fish farming was Bangladesh Taka BDT 506,632 (≈USD 6247.00) and BDT 212,600 (≈USD 2621.45) in rice-only practice, whereas net income was BDT 373,243 (≈USD 4602.25) and BDT 126,667 (≈USD 1561.86), respectively.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在填补孟加拉国西北部稻渔综合种养在采用路径、经济可行性与季节性收益方面的资料空白，通过参与式农村评估方法对Dinajpur Sadar分区的30个稻渔田块及其对照稻田进行比较分析。结果表明，稻渔模式主养鲤鱼和罗非鱼（放养密度约24,700尾/ha），水稻产量与单作无显著差异，但额外鱼产量显著提高了总收入和净收入，稻渔模式净收入（BDT 373,243）约为单作水稻（BDT 126,667）的三倍，效益成本比亦更优。

papers.title: Accidental Petroleum Hydrocarbon Exposure in Farmed Rainbow Trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss): Effects on Tissues, Water Quality, and Fish Muscle
papers.authors: Cala-Delgado, Daniel Leonardo; Duarte-Rodriguez, Luz Zoraya; Rivera Robayo, Fredy; Crosby Granados, Rene Alejandro; Navas-Rodriguez, Juan Carlos
papers.abstract: Accidental petroleum contamination can affect fish health and food safety in aquaculture, yet evidence from commercial production systems remains limited. This study evaluated the effects of an accidental diesel spill on a rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) farm operating under a continuous flow-through system in Santander, Colombia. Water and fish muscle were analyzed for petroleum hydrocarbons, and exposed fish were examined by histopathology and immunohistochemistry. Following the rollover of a diesel tanker truck, the producer reported a diesel-like odor, an oily surface film, and reduced feed intake, although no spill-related mortality was observed and water quality remained within acceptable ranges for trout culture. Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons were detected in production water, with 2-methylnaphthalene quantified at 21.2 μg/L. Fluorene, 2-methylnaphthalene, phenanthrene, and acenaphthene were quantified in muscle. Histopathology revealed lesions in the kidney, liver, gills, skeletal muscle, and intestine, including interstitial nephritis, hepatocellular lipidosis, branchial degeneration, myonecrosis, and villous atrophy. Melan-A immunoreactivity and negative Perls’ Prussian blue staining supported melanin-associated renal pigmentation. These findings indicate that accidental diesel exposure in a commercial flow-through rainbow trout farm can cause detectable PAH contamination and multisystemic tissue injury without acute mortality. Integrated chemical and histopathological monitoring is therefore advisable for aquaculture toxicology and food safety surveillance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了哥伦比亚一商业流水式虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）养殖场在柴油泄漏事故后的污染影响，检测了水体与鱼肌肉中的石油烃含量，并对暴露鱼体进行组织病理学和免疫组化分析。水体中检出多环芳烃（PAHs），其中2-甲基萘浓度为21.2 μg/L，鱼肌肉中检出芴、2-甲基萘、菲和苊。组织病理学显示肾脏、肝脏、鳃、骨骼肌和肠道均出现病变，但未发生急性死亡，水质指标仍处于虹鳟养殖可接受范围。结果表明，意外柴油暴露可在无急性致死的情况下导致可检测的PAH污染和多系统组织损伤，建议将化学分析与组织病理学监测整合应用于水产养殖毒理学与食品安全监管。

papers.title: Antimicrobial Use in European Aquaculture and the Aquatic Environment: From Regulatory Transformation to Sustainable Disease Management
papers.authors: Wojnarowski, Konrad; Zhao, Dongqing; Cholewinska, Paulina; Hou, Kangwei; Moniuszko, Hanna
papers.abstract: European aquaculture is increasingly shaped by regulatory efforts to reduce unnecessary antimicrobial use and limit antimicrobial resistance risks across the human–animal–environment interface. These efforts are necessary, especially where antimicrobials are used routinely or as a substitute for husbandry or a remedy for biosecurity failures. However, stewardship in aquaculture cannot be reduced to legal restriction or lower antimicrobial input alone. Fish diseases occur in heterogeneous systems, including recirculating systems, flow-through farms, ponds, hatcheries and marine cages, with different patterns of pathogen entry, treatment delivery and environmental exposure. This review examines antimicrobial use in European aquaculture through the conditions required to make reduction clinically and environmentally workable. Its central argument is that regulatory transformation depends on implementation capacity. Aquatic veterinarians are expected to justify and reduce antimicrobial use while responding to bacterial disease events that may progress rapidly, affect populations and threaten welfare. This decision space becomes difficult where diagnostic access, authorised medicinal products, vaccines, records, surveillance systems or aquatic veterinary expertise are limited. Prevention, biosecurity, diagnostics and surveillance are discussed as decision-enabling infrastructure rather than generic sustainability measures. They reduce preventable disease pressure, help distinguish bacterial from non-bacterial morbidity, support justified treatment and provide feedback on health and environmental outcomes. The aquatic environment is treated not only as a recipient of residues, resistant bacteria and resistance genes but also as a source of risk, exposure and governance information. Responsible antimicrobial reduction is, therefore, not simple minimisation. Sustainable disease management depends on connecting regulatory ambition with veterinary decision-making, therapeutic feasibility, diagnostic support and environmental feedback.
papers.summary_cn: 欧洲水产养殖正面临减少抗菌药物使用与遏制耐药性风险的双重监管压力，但单纯限制用药难以实现可持续疾病管理。本文综述指出，抗菌药物减量在临床和环境层面的可行性取决于实施能力，包括诊断可及性、授权药物、疫苗、监测系统及水生兽医专业力量等决策支撑条件。预防、biosecurity、诊断与surveillance应被视为赋能决策的基础设施，而非泛泛的可持续性措施；水生环境既是残留物和耐药基因的受体，也是风险与治理信息的来源。

papers.title: ESG performance and financing constraints in aquaculture and fishery listed companies: Evidence from China
papers.authors: Wang, Litao; Yin, Danni
papers.abstract: This paper uses Chinese A-share fishery-listed companies from 2009 to 2025 as the research sample, comprising 14 companies and 197 annual panel observations. Using a two-way fixed-effects model, it empirically tests the impact, transmission path, and heterogeneity of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance on the financing constraints of fishery companies. The ESG indicators are measured using a comprehensive rating of 0 to 100 points on the Huazheng Index, with higher scores indicating better overall levels of environmental compliance, social responsibility fulfillment, and internal governance of the company. Financing constraints are calculated using the KZ index, with a higher index value indicating greater financing constraints for the company. The study found that the regression coefficient of the comprehensive ESG score of companies is -0.069, which is significantly negative at the 5% statistical level, indicating that good ESG performance can significantly alleviate the financing constraints of fishery companies. Mechanism testing shows that subsidy acquisition and supply chain relationship governance are the two core transmission channels through which ESG mitigates effects. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the environmental dimension is the core driver of ESG in improving the financing environment for companies, and that the financing slow-release effect of ESG is more pronounced in aquaculture and fishery companies with low export dependence. This study is based on the local characteristics of China’s fisheries industry policies and industrial chain, and examines the economic effects of ESG in the agricultural sector. It can provide local empirical evidence to optimize green finance policies in the fisheries industry and to lay out ESG practices for listed aquatic companies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以2009—2025年中国A股14家渔业上市公司197个年度面板数据为样本，采用双向固定效应模型检验ESG表现对渔业企业融资约束的影响、传导路径及异质性。结果显示，ESG综合评分回归系数为-0.069（5%水平显著），表明良好ESG表现可显著缓解渔业企业融资约束；补贴获取与供应链关系治理是两条核心传导渠道。异质性分析表明，环境维度是ESG改善融资环境的核心驱动因素，且该缓释效应在低出口依赖型水产养殖与渔业企业中更为明显。

papers.title: Draft genome sequence of emerging Salmonella enterica serovar Kentucky ST198 isolated from broiler litter at an integrated poultry-aquaculture marketplace in Bangladesh
papers.authors: Amena, Bibi; Islam, Mohimanul; Rana, Eaftekhar Ahmed; Momin, Md. Moksedul; Miah, Gous; Uddin, Gazi Md. Noor; Bilkis, Tahmina
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Integrated live poultry-aquaculture marketplaces represent high-risk One Health interfaces where environmental circulation of zoonotic Salmonella poses a threat to public health. Using Illumina NovaSeq, this study delineates genomic features of a Salmonella Kentucky ST198 strain, providing insight into a globally disseminated lineage and a resource for future surveillance and epidemiological investigations.
papers.summary_cn: 研究对孟加拉国一个家禽-水产综合市场肉鸡垫料中分离的 Salmonella enterica serovar Kentucky ST198 进行全基因组测序（Illumina NovaSeq），旨在解析这一全球传播谱系的基因组特征。该菌株来源于活禽-水产综合市场这一高风险 One Health 界面，其基因组数据可为沙门氏菌监测与流行病学研究提供参考。

papers.title: Distribution and New Fish Host for the Parasitic Isopod Livoneca redmanii Leach, 1818 (Crustacea: Cymothoidae) Collected in Northeastern Brazilian Coast
papers.authors: Nery, Saulo Felipe Souza; de Carvalho Paiva, Ricardo José; Martins, Déborah Elena Galvão; de Almeida Alves-Júnior, Flavio
papers.journal: Thalassas: An International Journal of Marine Sciences
papers.abstract: Abstract Isopods of the family Cymothoidae Leach, 1814 are frequently found as fish parasites in continental and marine environments, distributed in tropical and subtropical environments. The presence of these parasites causes histological and morphological damage to the health of their hosts, in addition to economic impacts on fishing. The isopod species Livoneca redmanii Leach 1818 occurs throughout the Atlantic Ocean, with a distribution that includes the Caribbean Sea, Brazil and, recently, the Mediterranean Sea (Egypt), parasitizing a wide range of estuarine/marine fish. In Brazil, this species is found mainly parasitizing fishes of the families Scombridae Rafinesque 1815 and Carangidae Rafinesque 1815. Thus, this study reports L. redmanii parasitizing a new host, the smallscale weakfish Cynoscion microlepidotus (Cuvier, 1830) (Sciaenidae), both collected on the coast of Maranhão, thereby expanding its list of hosts and geographic distribution in Brazil. The specimens of C. microlepidotus and their ectoparasites were collected in the municipality of Cedral (Maranhão, 02°00’34.8"S 044°30’30.3"W) by local artisanal fishermen, in June and July 2025. We analyzed 10 specimens of C. microlepidotus , containing 19 individuals of L. redmanii (4 males and 15 females) occupying the gill chambers. This report reinforces the need for studies on parasite-host interactions in coastal and estuarine ecosystems of Northeast Brazil, aiming to better understand their ecological and economic impacts. We also provide a host list for L. redmanii , showing its generalist and opportunistic nature. Furthermore, future research should investigate the dynamics of infestation in species of commercial interest.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究报道了等足类寄生虫 Livoneca redmanii 在巴西东北部海岸寄生新宿主——小鳞犬牙石首鱼（Cynoscion microlepidotus, Sciaenidae）的首次记录。2025年6–7月于马拉尼昂州Cedral采集的10尾宿主鳃腔中共检出19个L. redmanii个体（4雄15雌），扩展了该寄生虫的宿主谱与地理分布。文章同时提供L. redmanii宿主名录，指出其广宿主与机会主义特性，并强调需加强巴西东北部沿海及河口生态系统中寄生虫-宿主互作及其对商业鱼种侵染动态的研究。

papers.title: Cross hybridization Inference for Phylogenetic Resolution (CIPHR)-FISH enables microbiome imaging with strain level taxonomic resolution
papers.authors: Adade, Emmanuel E; Wang, Ruogu; Henneberry, Colin M; Lemus, Alex A; Stevick, Rebecca J; Perez-Pascual, David; Audrain, Bianca; Orsino, Alexa J; Farnsworth, Dylan R; Ghigo, Jean-Marc
papers.abstract: Abstract The spatial organization of microbial communities is a critical determinant of host-microbe interactions, yet species-level mapping remains challenging due to high 16S rRNA sequence homology and spectral crosstalk in multiplexed fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH). To address this challenge, we developed Cross-hybridization Inference for Phylogenetic Resolution (CIPHR)-FISH, a pipeline that integrates strategic probe design with supervised machine learning. CIPHR-FISH transforms probe cross-hybridization, traditionally viewed as experimental noise, into informative molecular signatures. Using a gnotobiotic zebrafish model colonized with a defined mix of 10 zebrafish bacterial strains, we trained a support vector machine (SVM) on empirical hybridization patterns from pure bacterial cultures. CIPHR-FISH achieved 99.2 % macro-averaged accuracy, significantly outperforming standard linear unmixing (62.5 %), and successfully discriminated strains with 99.7% sequence homology. Applying this tool to gnotobiotic zebrafish larvae revealed distinct biogeographies: the intestinal bulb hosted highly structured, multi-layered polymicrobial aggregates, while the skin exhibited sparse, uniformly dispersed individual bacterial cells. Notably, we observed significant variation in spatial community structure that was obscured by traditional bulk 16S rRNA sequencing. CIPHR-FISH provides a robust framework for high-resolution spatial biology by converting the limitations of molecular labeling into a rich data source for taxonomic classification. This approach enables the quantification of micro-scale ecological and stochastic forces that shape the microbiome across hosts.
papers.summary_cn: 开发了CIPHR-FISH方法，通过将探针交叉杂交信号转化为分子特征并结合支持向量机（SVM）分类，实现菌株级分类分辨率的微生物组空间成像。在定菌斑马鱼模型中，该方法对10株细菌的宏平均准确率达99.2%，显著优于传统线性解混（62.5%），并可区分16S rRNA序列同源性高达99.7%的菌株。应用于斑马鱼幼鱼后揭示了肠道球部与皮肤上截然不同的微生物空间分布格局，展现了传统bulk 16S rRNA测序无法捕捉的空间群落结构差异。

papers.title: Contrasting fish and phytoplankton community structure along a seasonally dynamic regulated Afro-tropical river
papers.authors: Ugbor, Ogechi Nnabuchi; Amoutchi, Amien Isaac; Uka, Anyaele; Omoigberale, Michael Osasele; Mehner, Thomas
papers.abstract: Abstract River regulation alters environmental conditions and hydrological connectivity, yet these influences are embedded within natural longitudinal and seasonal variation. We examined fish and phytoplankton community structure across 15 sites along the Lower Niger River, regulated by two dams, during dry and rainy seasons. We evaluated compositional differences among upstream, inter-dam and downstream sections, partitioned taxonomic β-diversity into turnover and nestedness, and assessed environmental, spatial and dam associated positional contributions to community variation. Both assemblages differed among river sections defined by their position relative to the dams, although differentiation was stronger for phytoplankton. Taxonomic β-diversity was consistently dominated by species turnover, accounting for approximately 90% of fish and 72–74% of phytoplankton β-diversity. Fish showed weak correspondence with measured environmental, spatial and fragmentation gradients, despite stronger compositional differentiation during the rainy season. Phytoplankton showed stronger environmental and dam-associated spatial structuring, with dam separation being particularly important during the rainy season. Environmental, spatial and dam-associated positional components were strongly shared, particularly for rainy-season phytoplankton community composition, showing that these components are closely intertwined along the regulated river continuum. Overall, community structure reflected high taxonomic replacement and assemblage-specific responses to interconnected environmental, spatial and river-regulation-associated patterns, with actively dispersing fish showing weaker structuring than the smaller, passively dispersed phytoplankton. This contrast emphasizes the value of considering multiple biological groups with different dispersal characteristics when assessing biodiversity patterns in regulated tropical rivers.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了受两座大坝调节的尼日尔河下游15个样点在旱季与雨季的鱼类和浮游植物群落结构，通过β多样性分解及环境、空间与大坝位置因素的贡献分析，揭示河流调节对群落的影响。两种群落在坝上、坝间和坝下区段间均存在分化，浮游植物分化更强；分类β多样性以物种周转为主（鱼类约90%，浮游植物72–74%）。鱼类与所测环境、空间及破碎化梯度对应较弱，而浮游植物受环境和坝相关空间结构影响更强，且各因素高度交织；主动扩散的鱼类受结构化影响弱于被动扩散的浮游植物，表明评估受调节热带河流生物多样性需兼顾不同扩散特性的生物类群。

papers.title: Upstream distribution and dam passage of native Sea Lamprey (Petromyzon marinus) following improved basin connectivity in the Penobscot River, Maine
papers.authors: Dillingham, Cody; Katz, Lara Sophie; York, Geneva; Frechette, Danielle; Zydlewski, Joseph D.
papers.abstract: Sea Lamprey are a native species in Maine’s rivers and have been in steep decline due to habitat fragmentation. Recent river connectivity improvements in the Penobscot River increased habitat access, but the effects of these changes are still being assessed. We used eDNA and radio telemetry to assess the current habitat use and dam passage for Sea Lamprey in the Penobscot River. We then compared these results with previous studies and historical data to quantify changes in Sea Lamprey distribution through time. Our results show that the distribution of Sea Lamprey decreased by 84% between the 1800’s and 2007. Restoration efforts have increased the species’ distribution by 45% between 2007 and 2023, but the species remains limited to only 23% of its historical range. Extant dams continue to prevent the expansion of Sea Lamprey. Many Penobscot River dams lack fish bypasses and passage performance is highly variable among dams with bypasses (0%-96% overall passage success between 2020 and 2023). Improved passage at dams remains an important direction for restoration of these native fish.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用eDNA与radio telemetry评估了Penobscot River中native Sea Lamprey的栖息地利用与dam passage现状，并结合历史数据量化其分布变化。结果显示，1800年代至2007年间该物种分布缩减84%，2007至2023年恢复努力使分布扩大45%，但仍仅占历史范围的23%。现存dam持续阻碍其扩散，且有无鱼道及鱼道性能差异显著（2020–2023年passage success为0%–96%），改善dam passage仍是该native fish恢复的关键方向。

papers.title: First cytogenetic characterization of the southern pygmy perch Nannoperca australis (Teleostei: Percichthyidae): Karyotype, heterochromatin and repetitive DNA organization
papers.authors: Majtánová, Zuzana; Moy, Karl G.; Unmack, Peter J.; Ezaz, Tariq
papers.abstract: Abstract Chromosome organization and repetitive DNA distribution are important components of genome evolution in teleost fishes but remain poorly characterized in many species of ecological and conservation relevance. We performed a detailed cytogenetic analysis of the southern pygmy perch, Nannoperca australis , a small freshwater species widely used in studies of population structure and evolutionary ecology in southeastern Australia. Mitotic chromosomes were examined using Giemsa staining, C‐banding, CMA 3 fluorochrome staining, fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) with 5S and 28S rDNA probes, telomeric FISH and comparative genomic hybridization (CGH). While the diploid number was conserved (2n = 48), reflecting a broader stability within the Percichthyidae, we observed minor morphological variation likely due to differential chromatin condensation. No heteromorphic sex chromosomes were detected via CGH, suggesting a homomorphic state common in many teleost lineages. However, 28S rDNA loci showed pronounced inter‐individual variability, including a unique interstitial cluster in one male. This coexistence of a stable 2n = 48 template with highly dynamic rDNA clusters suggests that repetitive DNA turnover may drive individual‐level genomic diversity in isolated populations. These findings provide a preliminary cytogenetic baseline for N. australis and highlight the potential of repetitive DNA as a marker for population structuring and conservation management in fragmented Australian catchments.
papers.summary_cn: 对澳大利亚东南部小型淡水鱼类南方矮鲈（Nannoperca australis）进行了首次细胞遗传学表征，采用Giemsa染色、C带、CMA₃荧光染色、5S/28S rDNA FISH、端粒FISH及比较基因组杂交（CGH）分析其核型与重复DNA组织。结果显示二倍体染色体数保守（2n=48），未检出异型性染色体，但28S rDNA位点存在显著个体间变异。研究表明重复DNA的动态变化可能驱动孤立种群的个体水平基因组多样性，可作为种群结构与保护管理的潜在标记。

papers.title: Active nuclease inhibition over passive freezing secures the genomic archive of fish eye lenses
papers.authors: Klarian, Sebastian A.; Avendaño‐Herrera, Ruben; Valdes, Juan Antonio; Vargas‐Perez, Juan; Cárcamo, Carolina; Araya‐León, Henry; Fernandoy, Francisco
papers.abstract: Abstract Fish eye lenses offer a chronological archive of individual life histories and preserve genomic DNA. However, integrating ecological and genetic data is hindered by post‐mortem nuclease degradation, and standardized DNA preservation protocols for this tissue remain undefined. We evaluated chemical and thermal preservation methods to maximize DNA yield and integrity from fish lenses. Using a paired experimental design across three marine species, we demonstrate that chemical stabilization with TRIzol yields significantly higher DNA quantities (2654.7 ± 331.5 ng) than ultra‐low temperature freezing at −80°C (1425.4 ± 866.6 ng) or standard freezing at −20°C. TRIzol denatures endogenous nucleases upon contact, preventing the enzymatic fragmentation associated with passive freezing. This optimized protocol establishes a methodological standard for eco‐isotopic genomics, enabling the direct coupling of phenotypic chronologies with genotypes to assess marine population resilience.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在解决鱼眼晶状体死后核酸酶降解阻碍生态与遗传数据整合的问题，比较化学与低温保存方法对DNA产量和完整性的影响。以三种海洋鱼类进行配对实验，发现TRIzol化学稳定法提取的DNA量（2654.7 ± 331.5 ng）显著高于−80°C超低温冷冻（1425.4 ± 866.6 ng）和−20°C常规冷冻。TRIzol通过接触变性内源性核酸酶，防止被动冷冻导致的酶切片段化，为生态同位素基因组学建立了方法学标准，有助于将表型时间序列与基因型直接耦合以评估海洋种群恢复力。

papers.title: Widespread hybridization in sympatric populations of allis shad Alosa alosa (L.1758) and twaite shad Alosa fallax (Lacépède 1803): A transnational perspective for conservation and management
papers.authors: Belo, Ana F.; Lepais, Olivier; Mateus, Catarina S.; Quintella, Bernardo R.; Almeida, Pedro R.; Nachón, David J.; O'Leary, Ciara; Roche, William; Lassalle, Géraldine; Lambert, Patrick
papers.abstract: Abstract The dynamics of hybridization between co‐occurring species in environments that have been modified by anthropogenic activities are important for generating new understandings of how species respond to disturbance and to support conservation management. Accordingly, the patterns of hybridization between anadromous allis shad Alosa alosa (L.1758) and twaite shad Alosa fallax (Lacépède 1803) were investigated, where these species historically co‐occurred across rivers in Europe. Genetic and meristic data from 1102 individuals sampled at 24 coastal and riverine sites revealed hybridization occurred across their overlapping Atlantic range, with hybrids detected in all regions, including both first‐generation and later‐generation crosses, with prevalence and hybrid class distribution varying geographically. Four main hybridization patterns were identified, shaped by local species composition, spawning behaviour and habitat connectivity. Gill raker counts reliably distinguished parental species and F1 hybrids, but not later‐generation hybrids. Fork length, gill raker number and body condition differed between species and sexes, and were influenced by regional and habitat context. Intermediate traits in hybrids suggest potential ecological distinctiveness. Straying by A. alosa into catchments dominated by A. fallax likely promotes repeated hybridization and introgression. It is suggested that hybridization in this species complex is not solely a by‐product of anthropogenic disturbance but may also reflect adaptive processes enhancing population resilience and colonization capacity. Conservation and management frameworks should thus account for hybrids as a dynamic and functionally relevant component of Alosa spp. populations, and consider phenotypic thresholds (e.g. size) for improved identification and protection in the field.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在揭示同域分布的西鲱（Alosa alosa）与芬塔西鲱（Alosa fallax）在欧洲重叠分布区的杂交格局，基于24个沿海及河流站点1102个个体的遗传与形态计数数据进行分析。结果显示杂交在整个大西洋分布区普遍存在，涵盖F1及后代杂交个体，其分布受本地物种组成、产卵行为和栖息地连通性影响，呈现四种主要杂交模式。鳃耙计数可可靠区分亲本与F1，但无法识别后代杂交个体；杂交个体表型居中，可能具有独特生态位。研究认为该杂交并非单纯人为干扰的副产物，可能具有适应性意义，建议保护管理中将杂交个体视为Alosa属种群的动态功能组分。

papers.authors: Oddekalv, Mathilde; Berhe, Saron; Beumer, Larissa T.; Dahlmo, Lotte S.; Velle, Gaute; Haraldstad, Tormod; Hoff, Siv Nam Khang; Jentoft, Sissel; Vollset, Knut Wiik; Lennox, Robert J.
papers.abstract: Abstract Atlantification is increasing the inflow of warm, salty Atlantic water into the Arctic region. The fjords on the western coast of Svalbard are experiencing Atlantification, enabling boreal species, such as Atlantic cod ( Gadus morhua ), to expand their distribution northwards. Monitoring the seasonal occurrence and behaviour of species like Atlantic cod in Arctic fjords is therefore key for understanding how ocean warming may restructure Arctic ecosystems and affect native prey species like polar cod ( Boreogadus saida ), supporting improved management under climate change. By using acoustic telemetry, this study investigated the seasonal presence and movement patterns of 27 Atlantic cod in Isfjorden, Svalbard, over the course of 1 year, from August 2023 to August 2024. Atlantic cod showed seasonal changes in vertical distribution in Isfjorden, occurring at greater depths during winter and closer to the surface during summer. Their occurrence was also more frequent along the shoreline of the fjord. Furthermore, we observed that some of the Atlantic cod left the fjord during the winter months, and few individuals were observed returning, suggesting seasonal use of the fjord. Genomic analyses suggest that the Atlantic cod sampled include specimens that are genetically more similar to the non‐migratory Norwegian coastal cod as well as individuals that display genetic signals characteristic for the well‐known migratory Northeast Arctic cod. Remarkably, 2 years after tagging, one of the specimens, displaying a genomic signal most often associated with the non‐migratory coastal cod, was caught in Lofoten. Our findings highlight the potential shift in movement patterns and usage of Isfjorden as a habitat for the iconic migratory ecotype in recent years, but they underscore the need for further studies to illuminate the coupling of the genomic characteristics and their altered migratory behaviour. Finally, our study exemplifies how climate change is reshaping Arctic food webs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用声学遥测技术，对斯瓦尔巴Isfjorden的27尾大西洋鳕（Gadus morhua）进行了为期一年（2023年8月至2024年8月）的季节性存在与移动模式监测，旨在评估北极峡湾增暖（Atlantification）背景下该物种的分布扩张及其对北极生态系统的潜在影响。结果显示，鳕鱼冬季分布于较深水层、夏季靠近表层，且更多出现在峡湾岸线附近；部分个体冬季离开峡湾且极少返回，表明其对峡湾的季节性利用。基因组分析显示样本中兼有类似非洄游性挪威沿岸鳕和洄游性东北北极鳕的遗传信号，其中一尾标记2年后在Lofoten被捕获，提示Isfjorden作为洄游生态型栖息地的利用模式可能正在发生转变。

papers.title: Transcriptomic analysis reveals the immune response mechanisms of Acrossocheilus fasciatus against Citrobacter freundii infection
papers.authors: Wu, Zihang; Fang, Wenbin; Huang, Renxuan; Zheng, Shanjian
papers.abstract: Abstract Acrossocheilus fasciatus is an economically important freshwater fish species in China. In recent years, Citrobacter freundii infection has caused significant harm to the aquaculture industry. In this study, we performed histological observation and RNA‐seq analysis of the intestines and spleens of control (CK) and C. freundii infected A. fasciatus (EG). The results showed that infected fish exhibited abdominal haemorrhage, intestinal villous shedding, hydropic degeneration of hepatocytes and splenic sinus dilation with congestion. RNA‐seq analysis identified 3054 DEGs in the intestine and 7706 DEGs in the spleen, with 1247 overlapping DEGs identified by combined analysis. A substantial portion of these genes clustered within biological activities linked to immunity and metabolic regulation, particularly engaging immune‐related routes such as endoplasmic reticulum‐based protein maturation, alongside the complement system and coagulation signalling cascades. This study systematically reveals the synergy and division of labor between the intestine and spleen during C. freundii infection, providing fundamental data for understanding the immune response mechanisms of A. fasciatus and a theoretical basis for optimising disease prevention and control strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对感染 Citrobacter freundii 的 Acrossocheilus fasciatus 肠道和脾脏进行组织学观察与 RNA-seq 分析，以揭示其免疫应答机制。感染鱼出现腹部出血、肠绒毛脱落、肝细胞水样变性及脾窦扩张充血等病理变化，肠道和脾脏分别鉴定出3054和7706个DEGs，其中1247个为重叠基因，主要富集于免疫与代谢调控相关通路，包括内质网蛋白成熟、补体系统和凝血信号级联。研究系统揭示了肠道与脾脏在抗感染过程中的协同分工，为优化疾病防控策略提供了理论基础。

papers.title: Implementation of an Integrated Agricultural and Fisheries System in Padeg Village, Gresik Regency
papers.authors: Jahiroh, Luluk Atun
papers.abstract: Agriculture in Indonesia is currently facing significant pressure due to climate change. Agricultural systems that are highly dependent on climatic conditions and rely solely on rainwater are particularly vulnerable to these impacts. Extreme weather conditions, such as prolonged dry seasons, can lead to drought, reducing agricultural productivity and even causing farmers to lose their sources of income. This study discusses the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program of PT Pertamina Patra Niaga – Bitumen Plant Gresik, particularly the implementation of agricultural and fisheries integration in Padeg Village, Gresik Regency, where approximately 90% of the population are farmers. A unique characteristic of agriculture in this village is the absence of natural water sources. Nevertheless, farmers demonstrate strong commitment to agricultural innovation by integrating crop cultivation with fish farming, adopting agricultural technologies, and developing independent fish hatchery through biofloc technology. This integration serves as an effort to improve agricultural productivity and efficiency while promoting the economic, social, and environmental sustainability of the community.

papers.title: Strengthening Chitin and Chitosan Downstreaming to Enhance Indonesia Fisheries Export Competitiveness
papers.authors: Pujiastuti, Agustina
papers.journal: International Journal Of Humanities Education and Social Sciences (IJHESS)
papers.abstract: Indonesia has substantial potential to develop a downstream chitin and chitosan industry because shrimp-processing activities generate shell by-products that can be converted into higher-value biomaterials. However, the utilization of these by-products for industrial chitin and chitosan remains constrained by fragmented raw-material supply, limited commercialization of research and technology, inadequate standardization and quality assurance, limited industrial capacity, and weak institutional coordination. This study aims to assess the current status of downstream chitin and chitosan development in Indonesia, identify the structural factors constraining value-chain development, analyze policy gaps, and formulate a phased policy roadmap. A qualitative descriptive approach was applied using secondary data from regulations, policy documents, official statistics, scientific publications, and institutional reports. The analysis consisted of current-status assessment, root-cause analysis, problem prioritization, policy-gap analysis, policy-alternative assessment, and roadmap formulation. The findings indicate that the principal constraint is not the availability of shrimp-shell resources but the weak integration of the downstream value chain. A four-phase roadmap is proposed covering governance and value-chain integration, industrial development and technology commercialization, international competitiveness, and innovation and sustainability. The framework provides a policy basis for increasing value added and strengthening fisheries export competitiveness through circular utilization of fisheries by-products.performance
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了印尼甲壳素与壳聚糖下游产业的发展现状，识别制约价值链发展的结构性因素，并分析政策缺口以制定分阶段政策路线图。采用定性描述方法，基于法规、政策文件、官方统计及科研文献等二手数据，进行现状评估、根因分析、问题优先级排序及政策方案评估。研究发现，主要制约并非虾壳原料供应不足，而是下游价值链整合薄弱。据此提出涵盖治理与价值链整合、产业发展与技术商业化、国际竞争力提升、创新与可持续发展四个阶段的路线图，为通过渔业副产物循环利用提升附加值和增强渔业出口竞争力提供政策依据。

papers.title: Sensitivity Enhanced and Noises Suppressed Double-Fish-Tail-Shaped Fiber Bragg Grating Sensor for Heart Rate Monitoring
papers.authors: Chen, Yilin; Zhang, Xuman; Iqbal, Muhammad Afzaal; Wang, Ziye; Zhu, Guodong; Hu, Youyou; Zhao, Changzheng; Wang, Yuan
papers.abstract: Wearable fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensors offer attractive advantages for physiological monitoring. However, the weak strain generated by respiration and cardiac activity and the susceptibility to laser intensity noise and motion-induced disturbances remain major challenges. In this work, we propose and experimentally validate a flexible double-fish-tail structural FBG sensor employing differential intensity demodulation technology, which intrinsically supports dual-parameter sensing of respiratory rate and heart rate via frequency-domain separation. Wearable experiments demonstrate stable detection of both respiratory and cardiac signals under respective dedicated test conditions, verifying the dual-physiological-modality sensing capability of the device. A flexible polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS)-encapsulated double-fish-tail structure is designed to enhance strain transfer from thoracic deformation to the embedded FBG. First, finite element analysis is employed to optimize the sensor geometry, and a 60 mm sensing structure is selected based on its superior average strain response and sensor installation. The optimized sensor exhibits a strain sensitivity of 3.73 pm/με, more than doubling the sensitivity compared to the case where the grating is eccentrically mounted under the same double-fish-tail structure. Finite element simulations show that, compared to conventional rectangular packaging structures, this double-fish-tail geometry can achieve a strain amplification factor of up to 5.76 times. To improve the detection of weak physiological signals, an intensity demodulation scheme incorporating a reference channel is developed to suppress relative intensity noise (RIN) and dynamic common-mode disturbances. Under perfect optical path matching, the differential configuration effectively suppresses laser-induced intensity fluctuations and fiber-jitter-induced disturbances, reducing the noise standard deviation to below 0.071 mV, corresponding to an equivalent wavelength noise of 0.018 pm. Wearable experiments demonstrate stable detection of both respiratory and cardiac signals. A 5 min respiratory measurement yields a dominant frequency of 0.21 Hz, corresponding to 12.6 breaths/min, while repeated 18 s heartbeat measurements produce characteristic frequencies of 1.38–1.46 Hz, corresponding to heart rates of 82.8–87.6 beats/min. The proposed sensor combines enhanced strain sensitivity, low-noise high-speed demodulation, and flexible wearable integration, providing a promising approach for real-time physiological monitoring.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对可穿戴FBG传感器在呼吸与心搏微弱应变检测中易受激光强度噪声和运动干扰的问题，提出并验证了一种柔性双鱼尾结构FBG传感器，采用差分强度解调技术实现呼吸率与心率的频域分离双参数传感。通过有限元分析优化几何结构（60 mm传感结构），PDMS封装的双鱼尾设计使应变灵敏度达3.73 pm/με，较偏心安装方式提高逾一倍，应变放大因子最高达5.76倍；引入参考通道的强度解调方案将噪声标准差降至0.071 mV以下（等效波长噪声0.018 pm）。可穿戴实验稳定检测到呼吸信号（0.21 Hz，12.6次/min）和心搏信号（1.38–1.46 Hz，82.8–87.6次/min），为实时生理监测提供了兼具高应变灵敏度与低噪声解调的可穿戴方案。

papers.title: Hydrodynamics, Sensing, and Control in Schooling Fish
papers.authors: Kanso, Eva
papers.abstract: Fish schools are among the most spectacular examples of collective behavior in nature. Individual fish coordinate their motion with neighbors primarily through vision and flow sensing. Each fish generates flow disturbances that can influence the motion and energetics of nearby swimmers. Yet fundamental questions remain unresolved: To what extent can schooling be explained by passive hydrodynamic interactions, and where are individual-level sensing and control required to maintain group cohesion? This review examines collective swimming through the lens of fluid mechanics. By synthesizing experimental, theoretical, and computational studies spanning pairs of fish to large schools, I discuss how hydrodynamic interactions affect coordination, stability, and energetic cost. Flow interactions can yield robust pairwise coordination and locomotor benefits, but they can also drive collective instabilities and unequal benefit distributions in larger groups. These findings point to a fundamental interplay between hydrodynamics and sensory–motor feedback in the formation and maintenance of fish schools. More broadly, they suggest that hydrodynamics shapes collective swimming not only through energetic costs and benefits but also through the physical constraints it imposes on coordination, stability, and information flow within groups.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述从流体力学视角审视鱼群集体游动，综合实验、理论与计算研究，探讨个体间水动力相互作用对协调、稳定性及能量消耗的影响。水动力相互作用可产生稳健的成对协调与运动收益，但在较大群体中也会引发集体不稳定和收益分配不均。研究表明，鱼群的形成与维持依赖于水动力学与感觉—运动反馈之间的基本耦合，水动力不仅通过能量成本与收益，还通过其对协调、稳定性及群体内信息流的物理约束来塑造集体游动。

papers.title: Detection of Tenacibaculum spp. in Caligus rogercresseyi: Evidence of Potential Pathogen Carriage in Salmon Aquaculture
papers.authors: Ilardi, Pedro; Jerez, Eugenia; Valdes, Sara; Sandoval, Carlos; Romero, Jaime; Oliva, Harold
papers.abstract: Sea lice (Caligus rogercresseyi) are major ectoparasites in Chilean salmon aquaculture, causing economic losses and increasing fish susceptibility to secondary infections. Tenacibaculosis has recently emerged as the second leading cause of mortality in farmed salmon. Understanding whether sea lice may harbor or transmit bacterial pathogens is therefore highly relevant. A sea lice survey was conducted at an Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) farm in the Los Lagos Region, Chile. Twenty adult parasites (10 ovigerous females and 10 males) were analyzed using an integrated approach combining immunohistochemistry (IHC) with specific antibodies and conventional PCR with appropriate controls. IHC revealed positive signals for Tenacibaculum maritimum in the gastrointestinal tract and cuticle, and for Tenacibacuum dicentrarchi in the cuticle and ovigerous sac of C. rogercresseyi. A specific PCR test confirmed the presence of both pathogens, yielding amplification products of 1088 bp for T. maritimum and 284 bp for T. dicentrarchi. This study provides the first dual evidence, by PCR and IHC, of Tenacibaculum species in C. rogercresseyi. These findings suggest that sea lice may play a role in pathogen dynamics in salmon farming, highlighting the need for further research on their contribution to disease transmission within aquaculture systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查智利鲑鱼养殖场海虱（Caligus rogercresseyi）是否携带或传播细菌性病原。采用免疫组化（IHC）和常规PCR对20只成体海虱进行检测，在胃肠道、角质层及卵囊中检出T. maritimum和T. dicentrarchi。这是首次通过PCR和IHC双重证据证实海虱携带Tenacibaculum属病原，提示海虱可能在鲑鱼养殖病害传播中发挥作用。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic Analysis of Aquaculture Net Cages Under Coupled Netting-Fish-Sediment Interactions
papers.authors: Liu, Shuang; Cao, Zuwei; Lyu, Chao
papers.abstract: To address the limitations of existing studies that neglect sediment feedback and thus underestimate the complexity of the flow field, this study develops a three-dimensional hydrodynamic model for aquaculture cages that couples a porous-media representation of netting with a two-way discrete-phase model for sediment transport. Unlike traditional single-factor simulations, this work systematically evaluates three interaction scenarios: netting-only, netting-fish coupling, and netting-fish-sediment multi-factor coupling, thereby revealing key nonlinear hydrodynamic mechanisms that have not been reported before. The results demonstrate that sediment particles induce a distinct momentum-feedback-driven “local re-acceleration zone” downstream of the cage, increasing turbulent kinetic energy by 13.2% and reducing wake velocity attenuation by 6-8%. These findings confirm that sediment–fish–netting interactions significantly modify wake shear structures and must be accounted for to ensure accurate flow prediction. This study provides new mechanistic insights into multi-factor hydrodynamics and a refined modeling framework to optimize cage design, enhance water exchange, and support sediment management in intensive mariculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对现有网箱水动力模型忽略沉积物反馈、低估流场复杂性的问题，建立了耦合多孔介质网衣与双向离散相沉积物输运的三维水动力模型，系统比较了仅网衣、网衣-鱼类及网衣-鱼类-沉积物三种相互作用情景。结果表明，沉积物颗粒在网箱下游诱发动量反馈驱动的“局部再加速区”，使湍动能增加13.2%、尾流速度衰减减少6–8%，显著改变了尾流剪切结构。该研究为集约化海水养殖中网箱设计优化、水体交换提升及沉积物管理提供了新的机理认识与建模框架。

papers.title: From Sequence to Structure: AlphaFold and the AI Revolution in Aquaculture Drug Discovery and Vaccine Design
papers.authors: Üstüner, Enes; Öz, Mustafa
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Global aquaculture faces an escalating disease and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) crisis, exacerbated by climate‐driven physiochemical shifts and intensive farming practices. The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and structural biology, spearheaded by AlphaFold, represents a paradigm shift in aquatic pharmacology, transitioning the field from empirical trial‐and‐error to rational in silico design. This review critically evaluates the application of AI‐driven tools in aquaculture drug discovery and vaccine development. We examine the evolution of AlphaFold in predicting complex host–pathogen interactions and facilitating de novo drug design. Concurrently, we highlight critical limitations stemming from the reliance on multiple sequence alignment (MSA) depth rather than mere PDB taxonomic composition, the unreliability of direct molecular docking due to apo conformations, and the dynamic nature of psychrophilic adaptations in aquatic environments. Furthermore, we assess next‐generation structural vaccinology, including reverse vaccinology and pre‐fusion antigen stabilization, alongside the integration of nanomaterial‐based delivery systems to overcome aquatic pharmacokinetic barriers. The synergy of AI with CRISPR/Cas technologies and multimodal large language models (MM‐LLMs) for disease management is also explored. Despite unprecedented computational capabilities, significant bottlenecks remain, including a severe lack of species‐specific omics data, the indispensability of in vivo wet‐lab validation, and lagging regulatory frameworks. Ultimately, realizing the potential of precision aquatic medicine requires developing aquaculture‐specific databases, addressing the ecological risks of open‐water deployment, and democratizing these technologies for small‐scale farmers to ensure sustainable, equitable, and resilient global aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了以AlphaFold为代表的AI与结构生物学技术在水产药物发现和疫苗设计中的应用进展，重点评估其在预测宿主-病原互作、de novo药物设计及下一代结构疫苗学（如reverse vaccinology、pre-fusion抗原稳定化）方面的潜力与局限。作者指出，MSA深度依赖、apo构象导致的分子对接不可靠性及冷水性物种适应性等问题制约了预测精度，而物种特异性组学数据匮乏、活体验证不可替代及监管框架滞后仍是关键瓶颈。实现精准水产医学需构建水产专用数据库、评估开放水域部署的生态风险，并推动技术向小规模养殖户普及。

papers.title: Mud Crab Aquaculture: Biological Foundations, Production Bottlenecks and Sustainability Pathways in Scylla Farming
papers.authors: Patil, Atul R.; Chadha, N. K.; Jain, Amita; Prakash, Patekar; Hatte, Vinay; Narsale, Swapnil A.; Muralidhar, A. P.; Karthireddy, S.
papers.journal: Journal of Advances in Biology & Biotechnology
papers.abstract: Mud crabs of the genus Scylla support high-value fisheries and aquaculture across the tropical Indo-Pacific, yet the sector remains technologically uneven and closely coupled to wild resources. This critical narrative review evaluates the biological and production evidence underpinning Scylla aquaculture, with emphasis on species identity, broodstock and hatchery management, larviculture, nursery and grow-out systems, nutrition, environmental physiology, health and biosecurity, domestication, genetics, economics, and sustainability. Literature published from 1998 to 5 August 2026 was identified through agriculture, biomedical, multidisciplinary, and open scholarly indexes, supplemented by citation searching and authoritative institutional sources. Evidence was appraised for species verification, life stage, experimental design, replication, husbandry control, outcome validity, field relevance, and transferability. The literature shows that the principal constraint is not a single husbandry variable but a weakly integrated production chain. Hatchery survival remains inconsistent; nurseries are constrained by cannibalism and size heterogeneity; grow-out performance depends strongly on stocking design, shelter, feed quality, environmental stability, and disease control; and many farming systems still depend on wild broodstock, crablets, or subadult crabs. Species-level differences further limit the validity of transferring results among S. serrata, S. olivacea, S. paramamosain, and S. tranquebarica. Nutrition research demonstrates clear stage- and species-specific responses, but commercially validated formulated feeds remain limited. Disease reports increasingly implicate viral, bacterial, parasitic, and shell-associated syndromes, reinforcing the need for preventive biosecurity rather than reactive treatment. Domestication and genomic tools are advancing, particularly for S. paramamosain and S. serrata, but multi-generation selection, genetic management, welfare assessment, and independent economic validation remain sparse. The strongest pathway towards sustainable expansion is therefore an integrated one: species-verified captive seed production, standardised hatchery and nursery protocols, nutritionally adequate feeds, risk-based biosecurity, genetic stewardship, and explicit accounting for wild-seed dependence, mangrove interactions, labour, market risk, and animal welfare.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统评估了Scylla属青蟹养殖的生物学基础与生产证据，涵盖物种鉴定、亲本与育苗管理、幼体培育、养成系统、营养、环境生理、健康与生物安全、驯化、遗传、经济及可持续性等方面。核心发现是主要瓶颈并非单一养殖变量，而是生产链整合不足：育苗存活率不稳定、中间培育受同类相残和规格差异制约、养成依赖放养设计/遮蔽物/饲料质量/环境稳定性及病害控制，且多数系统仍依赖野生亲本或蟹苗。可持续扩张的关键路径在于整合物种验证的 captive seed production、标准化育苗规程、适宜饲料、基于风险的 biosecurity、遗传管理，并明确核算野生苗种依赖、红树林交互、劳动力、市场风险及动物福利。

papers.title: Consumer Substitution Behavior and Price Elasticity of Demand for  Fish Products in Coastal Nigeria: Empirical Evidence of Bayelsa  State
papers.authors: Achor, Prince Christopher
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF SOCIAL SCIENCES AND MANAGEMENT RESEARCH
papers.abstract: This study investigated the responses of fish consumption patterns of households in Bayelsa State, Nigeria to price volatility. The sampling technique used was mixed cross sectional method, where four Local Government Areas (LGAs) were purposively selected due to their nearness to fish activities and high fish consumption pattern. The respondents were selected by systematic random sampling. The number of questionnaires distributed was 400 of which 308 were recovered and the analyses were based on the 308 responded questionnaires. A structured questionnaire (Effect of Price Change on Fish Consumption Patterns (EPCFCP)). Cronbach's Alpha was used to determine the reliability of the instrument and was found to have an acceptable internal consistency. Data were statistically analyzed with descriptive statistics, Spearman's Rank Correlation and Ordinal Logistic Regression. The results indicated that price changes of fish were statistically significant and affected household fish consumption trend leading to a decrease in fish consumption and an increase in substitution with other protein sources. The Spearman's Rank Correlation indicated that there was a moderate positive and statistically significant correlation between changes in fish prices and fish consumption behaviour of household members (r = 0.547, p < 0.05). But there was very little and statistically insignificant negative relationship between responsiveness to fish price changes and the household income (r = −0.099, p = 0.083). The results of the Ordinal Logistic Regression also showed that the overall model was statistically significant and that the price change of the fish, consumption pattern, household income and gender were significantly influencing fish consumption behaviour. Price changes in fish proved to be best predictors. The analysis shows that the prices of fish have a significant effect on household consumption decisions. It suggests the need for investment in aquaculture, subsidy for fish producers and availability of cheap and affordable credit, development of adequate storage and distribution system, and measures to support the purchasing power of the fish household to improve food security and nutritional status.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以尼日利亚巴耶尔萨州为对象，采用问卷调查（n=308）结合Spearman秩相关与Ordinal Logistic Regression，分析鱼价波动对家庭鱼类消费行为的影响。结果表明，鱼价变化显著降低鱼类消费并促使消费者转向其他蛋白来源替代，鱼价变化是消费行为的最佳预测因子，而家庭收入与价格响应之间关系不显著。作者建议通过投资水产养殖、生产者补贴、信贷支持及储运体系建设来提升水产品食物安全保障能力。

papers.title: A Fish Journey through Data: Long-Term Monitoring and Red Mullet Stock Status
papers.authors: Georgieva, Yoana; Klayn, Stefania
papers.abstract: Red mullet ( Mullus barbatus ) is one of the most valuable demersal fish species in the Black Sea, supporting important commercial fisheries while playing a key ecological role in benthic food webs. Due to its short life span (4-6 years), rapid growth, and sensitivity to environmental changes and fishing pressure, the species serves as an effective indicator of the states of the coastal ecosystems. Hence, biological long-term monitoring became essential for evaluating population dynamics and supporting sustainable fisheries management. This study implement fisheries-dependent long term monitoring data (2015–2025) to evaluate changes in the status of red mullet stock along the Bulgarian Black Sea coast. In the Black Sea, length-based indicators are crucial since the age determination remains affected by inconsistencies in otolith interpretation among laboratories, whereas length measurements are standardized, routinely collected, and highly reproducible. Annual analyses included total length, body weight, condition factor, and cumulative length-frequency distributions. These analyses were complemented by long-term ecosystem projections from an Ecopath with Ecosim (EwE) model to evaluate future biomass and catch trajectories under unchanged fishing pressure (F status quo). Mean total length (10.9–12.6 cm) and body weight (15.5–23.7 g) showed clear inter annual variability, while condition factor remained consistently stable, indicating good individual condition throughout the study period. Length-frequency distributions revealed generally stable population size structure but also marked year-to-year differences, with 2017 and 2023 characterized by a greater proportion of small individuals and 2024 by larger fish. Approximately 35% of the catch consisted of fish below the estimated size at first maturity (11.2 cm TL), indicating persistent harvesting of immature individuals despite the relative stability of the stock structure. Ecosystem model projections further suggest that, if current fishing mortality is maintained, both biomass and catches may decline by approximately 13% by 2050. The red mullet stock in the Black Sea remains overexploited (GFCM 2024). These results demonstrate the importance of long-term ecological monitoring for detecting gradual changes in exploited populations that may not be detected by the short-term data. Although the overall length structure remained relatively stable, the persistent occurrence of immature individuals in the catch indicates ongoing recruitment overfishing. Integrating long-term time series with ecosystem modelling provides a robust scientific basis for adaptive fisheries management and supports precautionary measures, including revision of the minimum conservation reference size, to improve the resilience of red mullet populations under future environmental and fishing pressures.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2015—2025年渔业依赖型长期监测数据，结合体长指标与Ecopath with Ecosim（EwE）生态系统模型，评估保加利亚黑海沿岸red mullet（Mullus barbatus）的种群状况。结果显示平均体长（10.9–12.6 cm）和体重（15.5–23.7 g）年际波动明显，但肥满度稳定，种群体长结构总体平稳；约35%的渔获物低于首次性成熟体长（11.2 cm TL），表明持续捕捞未成熟个体，存在补充型过度捕捞。EwE模型预测若维持当前捕捞死亡率，到2050年生物量和渔获量将下降约13%，该种群仍处于过度开发状态（GFCM 2024）。研究强调长期监测结合生态系统建模对适应性渔业管理和修订最小保护参考体长的科学支撑作用。

papers.title: Variation patterns and ecological drivers of morphology in different body regions of fishes from the Northwest Pacific Ocean
papers.authors: Wang, Chao; Yu, Jun; Ding, Zhaoxia; Liu, Bilin; Chen, Xinjun; Fang, Zhou
papers.abstract: Abstract Variation in fish body morphology represents an important aspect of phenotypic diversity and plays a fundamental role in understanding fish evolution and ecology. The complex oceanographic conditions of the Northwest Pacific Ocean create diverse selective pressures, making it an ideal system for studying how environmental variability shapes fish body morphology. While previous macroecological studies have linked fish morphology to environmental factors, the driving factors of regional morphological differences were seldom explored. In this study, morphological variations among different body regions (entire body, head, torso and tail) of 22 fish species from the Northwest Pacific Ocean were analysed to explore the phylogenetic and ecological drivers of these variations with geometric morphometrics (GMs) in a phylogenetic framework. The results showed significant morphological differences among orders and species. Entire body, head, torso and tail exhibited low to moderate phylogenetic signals. Ecological factors, including latitudinal range, temperature preference, fecundity and trophic level, significantly shaped morphological variations, thus emphasizing the complex interplay between ecological and evolutionary pressures. We confirmed that different body regions are subject to distinct selective pressures, reflecting the combined influence of genetic and environmental factors. Overall, this study highlights the combined influence of phylogenetic history and ecological pressures in shaping fish morphology. These findings improve understanding of fish evolutionary biology and provide a foundation for conservation and species management in the Northwest Pacific.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以西北太平洋22种鱼类为对象，采用几何形态测量学（geometric morphometrics）在系统发育框架下分析整体、头部、躯干和尾部等不同身体区域的形态变异，探讨其系统发育与生态驱动因素。结果显示，不同目和种间形态差异显著，各身体区域呈现低至中等系统发育信号，纬度范围、温度偏好、繁殖力和营养级等生态因子显著塑造形态变异。不同身体区域受不同选择压力，反映了遗传与环境因素的共同作用，为西北太平洋鱼类保护与物种管理提供了基础。

papers.authors: Lee, Kiah; Jourdain, Eve; Remili, Anais; McKinney, Melissa; Andvik, Clare; Fagerlund, Carl; Karoliussen, Richard; Borgå, Katrine; Ruus, Anders

papers.title: The overlooked role of food and cultural dimensions in recreational fisheries
papers.authors: Badhon, Mahatub Khan; Castello, Leandro; MacNeil, M. Aaron; Stern, Marc J.; Fiorella, Kathryn J.; Beaudoin, Christine; Coffin-Schmitt, Jeanne L.; Rice, Emma D.; Crowley-Aksamit, Claire K.; Andersen, Alyssa M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Our study examines the diversity of values within a superficially homogeneous recreational fishery and its relationship to angler diversity. We collected data on fishing preferences, behaviors, catch usage, and sociodemographics from 443 shore anglers across 10 cities in the lower Great Lakes. We identified five coherent dimensions, including food, cultural, leisure, challenge/performance, and social–financial centrality, consistent with multidimensional value structuring in recreational fisheries. Based on these patterns, anglers were classified into three data-driven groups along a food provisioning–leisure/sport continuum: provisioning/food-oriented, cultural/community-oriented, and leisure/sport-oriented. We further characterized these groups by differences in their fishing preferences and sociodemographics. These findings provide empirical support that recreational and non-recreational values coexist and jointly characterize angler diversity in urban shore fisheries. Our study highlights the need for future research and management to treat food provisioning and cultural practices as core dimensions of recreational fisheries that reflect anglers’ diverse values and needs.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于美国五大湖下游10个城市443名岸钓者的调查数据，分析休闲渔业中钓鱼偏好、行为、渔获用途及社会人口特征，识别出食物、文化、休闲、挑战/竞技及社会—经济中心性五个价值维度，并将钓者划分为食物供给型、文化/社区型和休闲/竞技型三类。结果表明，休闲与非休闲价值在休闲渔业中并存，食物供给与文化实践应被视为休闲渔业的核心维度，对未来研究与管理具有重要启示。

papers.title: Wintering Fish Habitat of Atlantic Chub Mackerel ( Scomber colias ) Southern Stock in SW Atlantic Ocean
papers.authors: Parietti, Manuela; Spath, M. Cecilia; Orlando, Paula; Menna, Bruno V.; Cascallares, M. Guadalupe; Buratti, Germán E.; Buratti, Claudio C.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The Atlantic chub mackerel ( Scomber colias ) is an important pelagic resource in the Southwestern Atlantic Ocean (SWAO), supporting socially and economically significant fisheries in Argentina. Two underexploited stocks occur on either side of 39° S, yet their economic importance and contribution to local employment require continued monitoring and informed management. During the austral winter, when most catches occur, the southern stock aggregates in the El Rincón area (ER), forming large, dense schools with pronounced vertical structure. This study identified the wintering habitat of S. colias and characterised the environmental conditions associated with this critical life‐history stage. Acoustic data from acoustic‐oceanographic surveys and official fishing reports between 2010 and 2024 were analysed. The presence and abundance of S. colias were evaluated, and bottom temperature and salinity, water column stability and depth were used as fixed predictors in generalised linear models (GLMs). The results demonstrate that these four environmental factors were related to the winter distribution of S. colias , enabling the delineation of its winter habitat, corroborated by the performance of the commercial fleet fishing on the ER. Combining fishery‐independent and fishery‐dependent data, a wintering habitat is characterised, with schools consistently occupying a narrow corridor aligned with the 50 m depth, defined by vertically homogeneous and thermally stable waters, with a restricted SBT (9.09°C–10.86°C) and SBS ranges (33.51–34.22). Identifying the environmental drivers shaping winter habitat use provides valuable insights for designing improved monitoring strategies and implementing spatially informed management measures for this socio‐economically important species.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于2010—2024年声学-海洋学调查与渔业报告数据，利用GLMs分析底层温度、盐度、水柱稳定性及深度对西南大西洋南群大西洋白腹鲭（Scomber colias）冬季分布的影响，旨在识别其越冬栖息地。结果表明，四个环境因子共同驱动其冬季分布，鱼群集中占据与50 m等深线一致的狭窄走廊，水层垂直均一且热稳定，底层温度9.09–10.86°C、底层盐度33.51–34.22。该越冬栖息地刻画为这一社会经济重要种群的监测与空间管理提供了依据。

papers.title: Leaning left: how turn bias and habitat complexity shape spatial cognition in a coral-reef fish
papers.authors: von Drenkmann, Helen; Klinke, Annabell; Brown, Culum
papers.abstract: Abstract In coral reef ecosystems, anthropogenic change is rapidly altering habitat structure, but the consequences for fish cognition remain poorly understood. We tested whether structural habitat complexity influences spatial learning and strategy use in the humbug damselfish ( Dascyllus aruanus ). Juveniles were reared in aquaria containing either high- or low-complexity coral structures and trained in a T-maze task, requiring the use of egocentric (turn-based) and/or allocentric (landmark-based) strategies to locate a reward. Performance was assessed using the number of trials to reach a learning criterion and latency to make correct decisions. Probe trials with conflicting cues assessed navigation strategies. Turn direction was the strongest predictor of performance. Fish trained to turn left reached criterion in fewer trials and consistently relied on egocentric strategies, indicative of a lateralisation bias. In contrast, right-turning fish increasingly relied on landmark cues during probe trials and made faster decisions when doing so, suggesting that allocentric strategies reduced the cost of acting against intrinsic turn biases. Contrary to our expectation, environmental complexity did not affect the number of trials required to reach criterion. However, high-complexity fish located the reward faster during early training and showed longer decision latencies during probe trials, suggesting greater sensitivity to landmark information when cues conflicted. Our results suggest that spatial task performance may be shaped more by turn biases and strategy use than by environmental complexity alone, highlighting the importance of considering intrinsic behavioural constraints when interpreting spatial cognition.
papers.summary_cn: 以 humbug damselfish（Dascyllus aruanus）为对象，研究珊瑚礁栖息地结构复杂性对空间学习与导航策略的影响。幼鱼分别饲养于高、低复杂度珊瑚环境中，通过 T-maze 任务结合冲突线索探针试验评估其 egocentric 与 allocentric 策略的使用。结果显示，转向方向（左转偏好）是任务表现的最强预测因子，左转鱼更快达标且依赖 egocentric 策略，右转鱼则更多依赖地标线索；栖息地复杂度未影响达标所需试验数，但高复杂度组早期定位奖励更快、探针试验决策潜伏期更长。研究表明，空间任务表现更多受内在转向偏倚与策略选择影响，而非单纯由环境复杂度决定。

papers.title: Beyond Impoverishment? A Socio-Ecological Analysis of the Drivers of Child Trafficking and Migration Between Two Fishing Communities
papers.authors: Koomson, Bernard; Adusei, Kwame; Abdulai, Dawuda; Yeboah, Eric Henry; Manful, Esmeranda
