papers.title: Effectiveness of Community-Based Periodic Closures for Octopus Fisheries in the Wakatobi Biosphere Reserve, Indonesia
papers.authors: Sahari, Sariamin; Rachmat, Basuki; Isman, Khairuddin; Asuhadi, Sunarwan; Musrianton, Muhammad; Rumpa, Arham; Ferlin, Akhmatul
papers.journal: Marine Fisheries : Journal of Marine Fisheries Technology and Management
papers.abstract: Small-scale octopus’ fisheries in tropical coastal waters are highly vulnerable to overexploitation due to open-access conditions and limited management capacity, leading to declining stock biomass and reduced catch productivity. Community-based fisheries management (CBFM) using time-area closures has emerged as a practical management tool to improve stock recovery and fisheries sustainability. This study evaluates the management effectiveness of a community-based open–close system (parimpari) for blue octopus (Octopus cyanea) fisheries in Kapota Wakatobi, Indonesia, using an adapted Management Effectiveness Tracking Tool (O-METT Management effectiveness was evaluated using input, process, output, and outcome indicators through field surveys in five coastal villages, interviews with 70 stakeholders, including fishers, community leaders, and fisheries officers, the Government of Wakatobi, and the fisheries monitoring data collected between 2024 and 2025. Results indicate that the open–close system contributed to overall management effectiveness, which remained low at 28.9% (bronze level), constrained by limited human resources and financial capacity, and weak monitoring outputs. Despite high community participation and compliance, insufficient benefit-sharing mechanisms and weak fisheries data systems pose risks to long-term sustainability. The study highlights the need to strengthen fisheries management inputs, improve monitoring systems, and integrate scientific stock indicators to enhance the effectiveness of community-based octopus fisheries management. Keywords: Community-based open-close system; octopus fisheries management; O-METT; small-scale tropical fisheries; Wakatobi Biosphere Reserve
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以印尼Wakatobi生物圈保护区Kapota岛为案例，采用改编的管理有效性跟踪工具（O-METT），通过五个沿海村庄的实地调查、70名利益相关者访谈及2024—2025年渔业监测数据，评估社区主导的章鱼渔业开—闭系统（parimpari）的管理有效性。结果显示，该系统整体管理有效性偏低（28.9%，铜级），主要受限于人力资源与资金不足及监测产出薄弱；尽管社区参与度和遵守度较高，但利益共享机制不完善和渔业数据系统薄弱威胁长期可持续性。研究建议加强管理投入、完善监测体系并纳入科学种群指标，以提升社区型章鱼渔业管理成效。

papers.title: Year-round spatial segregation and fisheries overlap of white-chinned petrels from multiple populations at South Georgia
papers.authors: Warwick-Evans, Victoria; Pearmain, Elizabeth; Phillips, Richard A.
papers.abstract: Abstract By-catch in fisheries is the leading cause of population decline in pelagic sea-birds. The white-chinned petrel (Procellaria aequinoctialis) is the most by-caught sea-bird species in the Southern Ocean, and many populations are in decline. To better understand by-catch risk, we tracked white-chinned petrels from three sites across South Georgia throughout the annual cycle. There was no spatial segregation among colonies in at-sea distributions of failed or non-breeding birds, but birds tracked during chick-rearing from the easternmost site (Cooper Island) and the centre (King Edward Point), travelled both east and west of South Georgia, whereas those tracked from the west (Bird Island) only travelled west. Consequently, white-chinned petrels from Cooper Island overlapped less with fisheries than those from the other sites. Habitat models suggest that white-chinned petrels from all sites foraged in areas with similar environmental characteristics and that suitable conditions were present both east and west of South Georgia. Thus, broad-scale areas of high by-catch risk could be identified from predicted distributions, but overlap at finer scales could be distinguished more clearly from tracking data. Although the driver of spatial segregation in foraging areas was unclear, it affects by-catch risk and has implications for conservation and management.
papers.summary_cn: 对南乔治亚岛三个繁殖地的白颏风鹱进行全年追踪，以评估其与渔业的叠加及混获风险。非繁殖期各群体在海上分布无空间隔离，但育雏期最东端（Cooper Island）和中部（King Edward Point）个体可向东、西两侧活动，而西部（Bird Island）个体仅向西活动，导致Cooper Island群体与渔业叠加程度较低。栖息地模型显示各群体利用相似环境区域，大尺度高风险区可由预测分布识别，但精细尺度的渔业叠加需依赖追踪数据；空间隔离机制虽不明确，却直接影响混获风险与保护管理。

papers.title: Comprehensive assessment of structural and functional quality indicators of fermented fish products
papers.authors: Yussupova, G. T.; Shadyarova, Zh. К.; Kurmangaliyeva, D. Б.; Daribayeva, A. A.; Zamzamova, N. T.
papers.journal: The Journal of Almaty Technological University
papers.abstract: A comprehensive evaluation of the structural and functional properties of fermented fish products based on tilapia (Tilapia nilotica) was carried out in this study. The scientific novelty of the research lies in the integrated assessment of the effect of fermentation level on textural properties, water-holding capacity, and microstructural organization of the product. The study included a control sample and samples with fermentation levels of 30% and 40%. Texture Profile Analysis (TPA), Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR), Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), water-holding capacity (WHC), and pH determination methods were applied. Statistical analysis was performed using ANOVA (p<0.05). The results demonstrated that increasing the fermentation level reduced hardness by 27-34% and increased water-holding capacity by 12-18%. FTIR analysis revealed changes in the secondary structure of proteins in fermented samples, while SEM results indicated trends in microstructural reorganization. A relationship between the structural and functional characteristics of the products was established. The most favorable results were obtained for samples with a 30% fermentation level. The findings indicate that fermentation is a promising technological approach for regulating the structural and functional properties of tilapiabased fish products.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以罗非鱼（Tilapia nilotica）为原料，综合评估了不同发酵程度（30%、40%）对发酵鱼制品结构特性、持水力和微观组织结构的影响，采用TPA、FTIR、SEM及WHC等方法进行分析。结果表明，发酵程度升高使硬度降低27–34%、持水力提高12–18%，FTIR显示蛋白质二级结构发生变化，SEM显示微观结构重组趋势，且结构特性与功能特性之间存在关联。30%发酵水平样品综合品质最优，发酵可作为调控罗非鱼制品结构与功能特性的有效技术手段。

papers.title: Heterojunction Engineering of POMOF and ZnO: A Promising Strategy to Boost Triethylamine Gas-Sensing Performance for Fish Freshness Evaluation
papers.authors: Mei, Meng; Zheng, Yi; Cheng, Kaixin; Yao, Bo; Wang, Liao; Wu, Juan; Xing, Xinxin; Wang, Yude
papers.abstract: Abstract Triethylamine (TEA) serves as a key indicator of fish spoilage, and its accurate detection is essential for assessing fish freshness. However, existing TEA gas sensors often suffer from low sensitivity, sluggish response/recovery kinetics, and high operating temperatures. To address these limitations, this study, for the first time, integrates polyoxometalate-based metal–organic frameworks (POMOF) with ZnO via heterojunction engineering to construct a POMOF-ZnO heterojunction gas sensor. At an operating temperature of 140 °C, the sensor exhibits outstanding performance toward 10 ppm TEA, including a high response value (64.54), fast response/recovery times (49/108 s), excellent selectivity, and good long-term stability over 32 days. Material characterization reveals that the heterojunction formed between POMOF and ZnO significantly increases the number of active sites on the material surface. Furthermore, combining density functional theory (DFT) calculations, current–voltage (I–V) measurements, and in-situ Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) analysis, the underlying gas-sensing mechanism is systematically and comprehensively discussed. The practical applicability of the sensor is demonstrated by its successful detection of TEA released from crucian carp during room-temperature storage, highlighting its potential for rapid assessment of fish freshness. This work presents a novel approach for designing high-performance gas sensors based on POMOF-ZnO heterojunctions for fish freshness evaluation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次通过异质结工程将多金属氧酸盐基金属有机框架（POMOF）与ZnO复合，构建POMOF-ZnO异质结气体传感器，用于检测鱼类腐败关键指示物三乙胺（TEA）。该传感器在140 °C下对10 ppm TEA表现出高响应值（64.54）、快速响应/恢复时间（49/108 s）、优异选择性及32天长期稳定性，并结合DFT计算、I–V测试和原位FTIR系统阐明了传感机理。实际应用表明该传感器可成功检测鲫鱼室温贮藏过程中释放的TEA，为鱼类新鲜度快速评估提供了新型高性能气体传感策略。

papers.title: PIV-Based Characterization of the Hydrodynamic Effects of a Bubble Curtain Intended for Fish Guidance
papers.authors: Cîrciumaru, Gabriela; Dancă, Paul Alexandru; Chihaia, Rareș-Andrei; El-Leathey, Lucia-Andreea
papers.abstract: Bubble curtains are non-physical fish-guidance devices that modify the hydrodynamic and acoustic environment near water intakes. This study quantified the liquid-phase velocity field generated by a bubble curtain placed in the vicinity of a water intake in a laboratory open-channel testing rig using planar Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV). Measurements were carried out at a background water velocity of 0.33 m/s for air-injection rates of 0, 5, 8, 10.5, and 15 L/min. Velocity fields were obtained at distances of 0, 20, 30, and 50 mm from the porous hose, with detailed analysis performed at 20 mm. Bubble regions were identified and masked before liquid-phase image correlation. Air injection modified the local velocity direction and produced localized velocity increases, with a maximum local liquid-phase velocity magnitude of approximately 0.42 m/s. Relative to the no-airflow reference velocity of 0.33 m/s, the spatially averaged velocity magnitude increased by approximately 6.7%, 11.8%, 15.2% and 16.7% at airflow rates of 5, 8, 10.5 and 15 L/min, respectively; however, the incremental increase between consecutive airflow conditions decreased from approximately 4.7% between 5 and 8 L/min to 3.1% between 8 and 10.5 L/min and 1.3% between 10.5 and 15 L/min. The spatially averaged velocity magnitude increased with airflow rate, while the incremental response decreased progressively at higher air-injection rates. Thus, 8 L/min represents a candidate energy-efficient operating condition under the tested laboratory conditions. The results provide hydraulic information relevant to subsequent fish-behavior experiments; however, fish-guidance performance cannot be inferred from the present hydrodynamic measurements alone. The results provide a hydraulic basis for designing subsequent fish-behavior experiments. Because no fish were present during the measurements, the study does not assess fish attraction, avoidance, movement restriction, passage, entrainment, or guidance efficiency. Fish-guidance performance cannot be inferred from the present hydrodynamic measurements alone.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用平面PIV技术，在实验室明渠装置中量化了置于取水口附近的气泡幕所产生的液相速度场，测试背景流速为0.33 m/s，注气率分别为0、5、8、10.5和15 L/min。结果表明，注气改变了局部流速方向并产生局部增速，空间平均速度幅值随注气率增加而增大，但增量响应逐渐减弱，8 L/min在实验条件下为较节能的候选运行工况。研究未涉及鱼类行为观测，无法据此推断气泡幕的鱼类引导效果，但为后续鱼类行为实验提供了水力学基础。

papers.title: Blue Transformation Pathway for Nigeria and Africa: A Strategic Framework for Transitioning to 90%–95% Aquaculture Dominance by 2050
papers.authors: Martins, Anetekhai
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The global fisheries sector is undergoing a structural transformation, with aquaculture surpassing capture fisheries in 2022 (51% of global aquatic animal supply) and reaching 53% by 2024, when aquaculture production topped 100 million tonnes for the first time. Despite vast aquatic resources, Africa produces only approximately 1.9% of global aquaculture output and remains dependent on declining capture fisheries. Nigeria exemplifies this imbalance: aquaculture contributes only 26% of domestic fish production, while the country faces an annual supply deficit exceeding 1.7 million metric tonnes and incurs import costs of USD 700 million–1.5 billion. This paper proposes a Blue Transformation Pathway (BTP), a phased strategic framework to transition Nigeria's fisheries sector to 90%–95% aquaculture dominance by 2050. The BTP comprises three phases: stabilization (2025–2030; ~20% aquaculture), expansion (2030–2040; ~42%), and dominance (2040–2050; 90%–95%), reflecting a smoothed 12.9% compound annual growth rate sustained across the full 28‐year horizon. It is supported by seven implementation pillars, feed innovation, energy transition, infrastructure, finance, technology, human capital, and governance reform, plus three value‐added pillars: blue carbon finance, knowledge economy development, and humanitarian aquaculture. Economic projections indicate potential creation of 5.9–12.6 million jobs, reduction of fish imports by up to USD 6.2 billion annually, and a GDP contribution of 5.5%–7.5% by 2050, with additional gains from Sargassum utilization. The study concludes that Nigeria's aquaculture transition is feasible and scalable, offering a replicable model for sustainable fisheries transformation across Africa.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究提出“蓝色转型路径”（Blue Transformation Pathway, BTP），旨在通过分阶段战略框架推动尼日利亚渔业部门到2050年实现90%–95%的 aquaculture 主导地位，以扭转其水产养殖仅占国内鱼产量26%、年供应缺口超170万吨及进口支出高达7亿–15亿美元的失衡局面。BTP分为稳定期（2025–2030）、扩张期（2030–2040）和主导期（2040–2050）三个阶段，对应12.9%的复合年增长率，并由饲料创新、能源转型、基础设施、金融、技术、人力资本和治理改革七大支柱及蓝色碳金融、知识经济和人道主义水产养殖三大增值支柱支撑。经济预测显示，该路径有望创造590万–1260万个就业岗位，每年减少鱼类进口支出至多62亿美元，到2050年GDP贡献达5.5%–7.5%，并为非洲可持续渔业转型提供可复制模式。

papers.title: Species-specific loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) assays for the detection of three blood flukes affecting bluefin tuna aquaculture
papers.authors: Carabott, Melissa J.; Power, Cecilia; Shirakashi, Sho; Ramsland, Paul A.; Nowak, Barbara F.; Bott, Nathan J.
papers.abstract: Abstract Blood flukes of the genus Cardicola (Digenea: Aporocotylidae) are well-documented health threats to farmed and ranched bluefin tuna (BFT), where infections can result in substantial economic losses. While recombinase polymerase assays (RPA) have been developed for two species of Cardicola , the high degree of sequence conservation across all three species reported from BFT requires an alternative method to enable confident species-level discrimination. The aims of this study were to design, optimise and validate loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) for the detection of the three Cardicola species which infect BFT, and apply the assays to Pacific bluefin tuna (PBT) cultured in Japan. Species-specific LAMP assays were successfully designed, optimised and validated for C. forsteri , C. opisthorchis and C. orientalis targeting ITS-2 ribosomal DNA. In addition, these assays were applied to DNA from three sample types targeting sites of significant pathology, the heart, gill necropsy and gill biopsy of 15 PBT. Results were compared to outputs of quantitative polymerase chain reactions (qPCR), the gold standard for blood fluke detection in ranched Australian SBT, where LAMP assays were shown to be more sensitive. This research constitutes the first development and application of species-specific LAMP diagnostics for the three described Cardicola species infecting BFT, providing a rapid, cost-effective and accessible alternative to standard molecular diagnostics, informing management and treatment decisions.
papers.summary_cn: 针对养殖蓝鳍金枪鱼（BFT）的三种血吸虫（Cardicola forsteri、C. opisthorchis、C. orientalis），本研究设计、优化并验证了基于ITS-2 rDNA的种特异性LAMP检测方法，以克服三种虫种序列高度保守导致RPA难以区分的问题。将LAMP应用于日本养殖太平洋蓝鳍金枪鱼（PBT）的心脏、鳃剖检和鳃活检样本，并与qPCR金标准比较，结果显示LAMP灵敏度更高。这是首个针对感染BFT的三种Cardicola的种特异性LAMP诊断方法的开发与应用，为养殖管理提供快速、经济的替代检测手段。

papers.title: Investigating multi-modal detection for unmanned marine vehicles: magnetic vs. synthetic aperture sonar and gravimetry
papers.authors: Karst, Jeremy; Sunkara, Vishwamithra; Luttrell, Joseph; Riedel, Ralf; Thompson, James; Nilges, Corey
papers.abstract: Unmanned maritime vehicles (UMVs) are increasingly used in several maritime domain applications including seafloor mapping, mine countermeasures, pipeline and infrastructure inspection, and unexploded ordnance detection. While each application presents unique challenges in terms of target characteristics, platform constraints, and environmental conditions, mission planners often lack quantitative guidance for optimal sensor selection. In this paper, we present a simulation-based comparison of magnetic radiometry, gravity sensing, and synthetic aperture sonar (SAS). We assembled multidomain modeling frameworks coupling COMSOL magnetostatic analysis with analytical ellipsoid approximations, gravity anomaly calculations, and a complete SAS model benchmarked against Kraken Robotics specifications. Comparative simulations across targets ranging from small ordnance to submarines yielded several clear results. Gravity sensors, while appealing because they can detect any mass regardless of material, lack sufficient sensitivity for practical UMV integration given current technology simulations. Magnetic sensing dominates when targets are ferrous and buried, where acoustic penetration is limited, while SAS provides advantages for wide-area search and non-magnetic target detection. Based on these findings, we provide a calibrated, openly available SAS detection-range model, together with supporting magnetic and gravimetric analyses, intended to place these modalities on a common footing for systems design and mission planning. The model components are drawn from established sonar theory; the contribution is an accessible, hardware-referenced tool for multi-modal sensor comparison rather than a new detection method. The framework provides mission planners with quantitative guidance for multi-modal sensor deployment strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 研究通过仿真比较了磁力测量、重力传感与synthetic aperture sonar（SAS）在无人海上航行器（UMV）目标探测中的性能，构建了耦合COMSOL静磁分析、椭球近似、重力异常计算及基于Kraken Robotics规格的完整SAS模型的多域建模框架。结果表明，重力传感器虽可探测任意质量目标，但当前技术灵敏度不足以实用集成；磁力传感在铁磁性、掩埋目标（声波穿透受限）场景中占优，SAS则适用于广域搜索和非磁性目标探测。研究提供了一个开放可用的SAS探测距离模型及配套磁力与重力分析工具，为多模态传感器部署的系统设计与任务规划提供定量参考。

papers.title: Functional similarity shapes global patterns of fish naturalization and invasion richness
papers.authors: Xia, Zhijun; Chen, Juanjuan; Jeppesen, Erik; Guo, Kun; Su, Guohuan; Liu, Guohao; Yu, Fandong; Messyasz, Beata; Li, Jialin; Zhu, David Z.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: Freshwater ecosystems are among the most threatened by biological invasions, but it remains unclear why some exotics are more likely to be successful (known as naturalization success) and why some communities tend to harbor more exotics than others (measured as invasion richness). Here, using trait-based analysis, we addressed the knowledge gaps based on data from 1,691 fish communities worldwide. We found a latitudinal pattern of naturalization success, showing that successful exotic species were functionally more similar to native species at high latitudes than at low latitudes. Furthermore, the latitudinal gradient of invasion success was driven by contemporary climate, with higher exotic-native functional similarity in stressful climate conditions (i.e., high latitudes), while the opposite was observed in benign climates (i.e., low latitudes). Functional similarity was further positively associated with invasion richness, suggesting that preadaptations to novel environments (i.e., high similarity) may facilitate invasion richness. Moreover, invasion richness increased with increasing basin area and human pressure, but the effect of native diversity on richness was variable. Overall, the results highlight the joint influence of ecological processes (i.e., environmental filtering and niche differentiation) and human activities on fish invasions, with the relative role of ecological processes being well-elucidated through functional similarity.
papers.summary_cn: 基于全球1691个鱼类群落数据，采用基于性状的分析方法，探讨外来鱼类自然化成功率与群落入侵丰富度的驱动机制。研究发现，高纬度地区成功入侵的外来种与本地种功能相似度更高，且这一纬度格局由当代气候驱动——胁迫性气候条件下外来-本地功能相似度更高，而良性气候下则相反。功能相似度与入侵丰富度正相关，表明对新环境的高预适应可促进入侵丰富度；入侵丰富度还随流域面积和人类压力增加而上升，但本地多样性的影响不一。

papers.title: Heavy-Metal Rankings Across Sediment Risk, Seafood Bioaccumulation and Dietary Hazard in the Maowei Sea, China
papers.authors: Zhang, Enze; Deng, Lijiao; Zeng, Jun; Lai, Junxiang; Li, Hao
papers.abstract: Sediment indices usually set heavy-metal priorities in mariculture bays, but uptake and regulation vary among taxa, so seafood priorities may differ. In a single-season survey of the Maowei Sea (Beibu Gulf) in April 2022, seven metals were measured in water (27 stations), sediment (15 stations) and seven commercial taxa, each represented by the mean of 12 separately analysed station composites. We compared their rankings across sediment risk, bioaccumulation and dietary hazard. Cd and Hg contributed 85% of the sediment ecological risk index. Biota-sediment accumulation factors were highest for Cd in clams, Zn in oyster, Cu in crustaceans and Hg in fish. At an assumed 10% inorganic-As fraction, dietary hazard indices exceeded 1 for hard clam (1.44) and mitten crab (1.04). At 5%, no taxon exceeded 1. Under both fractions, the leading dietary metal in most taxa was As or Cu, not Cd or Hg. Cd or Hg took over in clams and fish at lower fractions, but not in crustaceans or oyster. In this survey, sediment rankings were a weak guide to seafood priorities, which argues for monitoring by taxon and metal. Measuring tissue As speciation should come first, since the dietary ranking depends on it.
papers.summary_cn: 为评估沉积物重金属风险排序能否代表海产品安全优先序，在茅尾海（北部湾）2022年4月单航次调查中，同步测定水体（27站）、沉积物（15站）及7类经济物种（每类由12个站位混合样均值代表）中7种重金属，比较其在沉积物风险、生物累积与膳食危害间的排序差异。结果显示，Cd和Hg贡献了沉积物生态风险指数的85%，但生物-沉积物累积因子（BSAF）最高的金属因类群而异（蛤类Cd、牡蛎Zn、甲壳类Cu、鱼类Hg）。在假定无机As占比10%时，硬壳蛤（1.44）与中华绒螯蟹（1.04）的膳食危害指数超过1，而5%时均未超标；多数类群的首要膳食风险金属为As或Cu而非Cd或Hg。研究表明沉积物排序对海产品优先序的指示作用有限，应推行按类群和金属的监测，并优先开展组织As形态分析。

papers.title: Climate-mediated population declines in the common Floridian coral, Porites astreoides
papers.authors: Vaughn, Kelsey M.; Brown, Christian H.; Hane, Clarissa J.; Porter, James W.
papers.abstract: Despite global coral reef degradation, Porites astreoides has become increasingly dominant on Florida and Caribbean reefs and is often considered climate-resilient. However, whether its apparent success reflects an increase in absolute abundance or simply a rise in relative abundance remains unclear, as does its ability to persist under continued climate stress. Using Coral Reef Evaluation and Monitoring (CREMP) data from 40 sites across the Florida Keys Reef Tract from 2011–2024, we evaluated temporal changes in colony abundance, percent cover, time-specific population growth, and colony size-class distributions of P. astreoides . We compared these responses with commonly observed species, Siderastrea siderea and Montastraea cavernosa . We then implemented a hurdle model to assess the projected response of coral cover, colony abundance, and probability of extinction related to Degree Heating Weeks (DHW) and water depth. For P. astreoides , increasing DHW was associated with decreased population growth and percent cover, demonstrating stronger negative responses than both comparison species. Projected population growth based on colony abundance fell below replacement at approximately 7.5 DHW. The relationship with DHW was largely driven by the 2023 mass-bleaching event. However, the negative relationship found between DHW, as well as the large (47.3%) decline in percent cover following the heat wave, suggests that tissue loss and reductions in colony size may precede declines in colony abundance. P. astreoides abundance and percent cover responded negatively to increased water depth, although for percent cover, deeper reefs may partially buffer the negative effect of thermal stress. Following the 2023 marine heatwave, medium and large P. astreoides colonies declined substantially while small colonies made up an increasing proportion of the population. Collectively, these findings indicate that the continued presence and increasing relative dominance of P. astreoides should not be interpreted as evidence of climate resilience. Instead, the species appears to be undergoing demographic decline and size structure diminution, which may be masked when either colony abundance or percent cover is considered alone. Evaluating population growth, percent cover, and colony size structure together provides a more complete assessment of coral resilience and the capacity of future reefs to maintain structural complexity and ecosystem function.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2011–2024年Florida Keys Reef Tract 40个站点的CREMP监测数据，研究评估了常见珊瑚*Porites astreoides*在气候胁迫下的种群动态，并与*Siderastrea siderea*和*Montastraea cavernosa*进行比较。结果显示，*P. astreoides*的种群增长和percent cover随Degree Heating Weeks（DHW）增加而下降，响应强度超过两个对照种，种群增长约在7.5 DHW时降至替代水平以下，2023年大规模bleaching事件后percent cover下降47.3%。该物种虽在相对丰度上呈优势，但实际正经历种群衰退和群体大小结构小型化，其气候韧性被高估；需综合population growth、percent cover和colony size structure才能准确评估珊瑚韧性。

papers.title: Winter feeding during the spawning migration of capelin north of Iceland
papers.authors: Petursdottir, Hildur; Silva, Teresa; Jonsson, Sigurdur Th.; Singh, Warsha
papers.abstract: Abstract Winter feeding during the spawning migration of capelin is often assumed to be minimal, because energy is allocated to reproduction. However, January–February surveys north of Iceland in 2018 and 2019 showed that prey occurred in 64% and 62% of 423 stomachs examined, respectively. Copepods ( Calanus spp.) and euphausiids dominated the diet, and mean feeding intensity tended to be higher by day than by night. Mean winter feeding intensity was lower than autumn values estimated using the same approach, but feeding was still present. These observations indicate that capelin feed during the winter spawning migration.
papers.summary_cn: 2018和2019年1—2月冰岛北部调查显示，毛鳞鱼（capelin）在冬季产卵洄游期间并非如通常假设的那样几乎不摄食：423个胃含物中分别有64%和62%检出饵料，以哲水蚤（Calanus spp.）和磷虾类为主，白天摄食强度总体高于夜间。冬季平均摄食强度低于采用相同方法估算的秋季值，但摄食行为确实存在，表明毛鳞鱼在冬季产卵洄游期间仍持续摄食。

papers.title: Method of meal delivery influences estimates of postprandial metabolism and alkaline tide in a benthic fish
papers.authors: Chen, Junlin; Wolfe, Barrett W.; Goodrich, Harriet R.
papers.abstract: Abstract Intragastric gavage is widely used in studies of digestive physiology to deliver standardised meals, yet it remains unclear whether it elicits postprandial metabolic and acid–base responses comparable to voluntary feeding. Here, we tested whether the method of meal delivery affects the magnitude and timing of the postprandial rise in metabolic rate known as specific dynamic action (SDA) and the associated alkaline tide (transient rise in blood pH and bicarbonate following feeding) in sand flathead ( Platycephalus bassensis ) using a standardised 1.5% body‐weight ratio either as intact pellets (voluntary feeding) or as a homogenised slurry via gavage, alongside fasted and sham‐gavage controls. SDA magnitude was ~3.6‐fold greater and duration was ~37 h longer in voluntarily fed fish. Removing the post‐handling period reduced this difference, and the early post‐entry period accounted for a greater proportion of metabolic expenditure in voluntarily fed fish, suggesting apparent differences partly reflect procedural effects of feeding method, including the mandated use of anaesthesia during the gavage procedure. Voluntarily fed fish showed a clear alkaline tide, to our knowledge the first report in this species, whereas gavage‐fed fish showed no tide at 6 h, with lower blood pH and a delayed bicarbonate rise. Gut content distribution at 6, 12 and 24 h post feeding indicated reduced temporal separation between gastric acid secretion and intestinal neutralisation in gavage‐fed fish. These results show that method choice can modify digestive physiology in ways that should be considered when interpreting and comparing studies of postprandial responses in fish.
papers.summary_cn: 以沙鲬（Platycephalus bassensis）为对象，比较自愿摄食与灌胃（gavage）两种投喂方式对餐后代谢（SDA）及碱性潮（alkaline tide）的影响。自愿摄食组SDA幅度约为灌胃组的3.6倍、持续时间长约37 h，且仅自愿摄食组出现明显碱性潮，灌胃组6 h时无碱性潮并伴血pH偏低及碳酸氢盐上升延迟。结果表明投喂方式（包括灌胃所需麻醉操作）可显著改变鱼类消化生理响应，在比较餐后代谢研究时需加以考虑。

papers.title: Effects of visual stimulation on local field potentials in the midbrain medial longitudinal fasciculus nucleus of Cyprinus carpio
papers.authors: Zhao, Yang; Zhu, Mengfan; Zhang, Yi; Zhang, Wenjuan; Gao, Pengbo; Peng, Yong; Rong, Xuwei; Tian, Libo; Zhang, Yusen
papers.abstract: Abstract A bio‐robot is a hybrid system wherein human‐implemented intervention signals delivered through dedicated control techniques modulate the behaviour of a host living organism. Delivering targeted stimulation to specific brain regions of an organism can induce virtual sensory perceptions analogous to those evoked by natural stimuli, thereby eliciting targeted motor behaviours. This strategy constitutes a pivotal control mechanism for bio‐robots. Observations of locomotor behaviour in fish following local brain ablation revealed that neurons in the Nucleus of the medial longitudinal fasciculus (Nflm) project to the optic tectum and coordinate visually evoked locomotion. This study aimed to advance understanding of the neural rhythm encoding mechanism underlying vision‐related local field potentials (LFPs) in common carp ( Cyprinus carpio ). Light stimulation was applied to the visual organs of carp to elicit tail movements, while LFPs in the bilateral midbrain Nflm regions were recorded simultaneously. Continuous wavelet transform (CWT) was applied for time–frequency analysis of the LFPs, with relative power and Sample Entropy (SampEn) subsequently quantified. The results showed that unilateral visual stimulation of the carp induced elevated relative power of theta, alpha, beta, gamma and high‐gamma bands in the LFPs of the contralateral Nflm, and the SampEn of such LFPs was reduced (all adjusted p < 0.05). From an electrophysiological perspective, this study demonstrated that the Nflm is associated with visual signal processing in fish and that the contralateral Nflm regions exhibit a robust response to unilateral visual stimulation. This study provides theoretical support for the regulation of carp robots via Nflm electrical stimulation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以鲤鱼（Cyprinus carpio）为对象，探讨视觉刺激对其中脑内侧纵束核（Nflm）局部场电位（LFPs）的影响，旨在揭示视觉相关神经节律编码机制，为鲤鱼生物机器人的电刺激调控提供理论依据。通过对视觉器官施加光刺激并同步记录双侧Nflm的LFPs，采用连续小波变换进行时频分析并量化相对功率与样本熵（SampEn）。结果显示，单侧视觉刺激可升高对侧Nflm中theta、alpha、beta、gamma及high-gamma频段的相对功率，并降低SampEn，表明Nflm参与视觉信号处理且对单侧视觉刺激具有显著对侧响应。

papers.title: Confirmation of the presence of non‐native, self‐sustaining brook trout S alvelinus fontinalis and genomic distinction between populations in southwest Germany
papers.authors: Koene, J. Peter; Baer, Jan; Bartolin, Patrick; Jacobs, Arne; Frei, David; Ros, Albert; Vonlanthen, Pascal; Brinker, Alexander
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduced to Europe from North America in the 19th century, Brook trout, Salvelinus fontinalis , can negatively impact native fish communities, yet self‐sustaining populations remain rare in southern Germany despite a long stocking history. Here, we report a survey of 1618 electrofishing records from Baden‐Württemberg, identifying only three small streams harbouring established, reproducing populations. Population density in upstream reaches was positively associated with greater pH variation and warmer winter water temperatures (indicative of well‐water dominance) and negatively associated with stream depth. RADseq‐derived SNPs (203,484 loci) from 34 individuals revealed strong genomic differentiation among all three populations despite their geographic proximity. The degree of differentiation is high for introduced salmonid populations and may reflect multiple stocking events from distinct breeding lineages, post‐introduction genetic drift or a combination of both. The absence of recent stocking and the long‐term spatial containment of these populations to small headwater sections suggest that the ecological threat posed by S. fontinalis to native fish fauna in the region is currently limited.
papers.summary_cn: 对德国巴登-符腾堡州1618条电捕记录进行调查，仅在3条小溪中发现已建立且能自然繁殖的 non-native brook trout（*Salvelinus fontinalis*）种群。上游种群密度与较高的pH变异和较暖的冬季水温（指示地下水主导）正相关，与溪流深度负相关。基于34个个体、203,484个RADseq-derived SNPs的分析显示，三个地理邻近种群间存在强烈的基因组分化，可能源于多次来自不同育种谱系的放养事件及引入后的遗传漂变。由于近期无放养且种群长期局限于小源头溪段，该物种当前对该地区本土鱼类的生态威胁有限。

papers.title: A new cave nemacheiline loach, Triplophysa boduensis (Cypriniformes: Nemacheilidae), from Sichuan, China
papers.authors: Zhou, Shipeng; Lin, Xinglian; Yan, Wenchu; Fu, Guiquan; Huang, Shiyong; Zhou, Jiajun; Song, Zhaobin
papers.abstract: Abstract Triplophysa boduensis is described herein as a new hypogean species from a subterranean tributary of the upper Yangtze River in Gong County, Yibin City, Sichuan Province, China. It represents the first cave‐dwelling Triplophysa species recorded from Sichuan. The new species is distinguished from its congeners by a combination of the following morphological characters: body scaleless and lacking pigmentation; eye reduced, diameter 4.3%–6.5% head length (HL); posterior chamber of air bladder well developed; intestine unlooped and short; lips thick with shallow furrows, lower jaw spoon‐shaped and not covered by lower lip; caudal peduncle laterally compressed, depth uniform with weak adipose crests; pelvic fin tips not reaching the anus; caudal fin tips pointed; branched rays 9, 11, 6, 6 and 17–18 in dorsal fin, pectoral fin, pelvic fin, anal fin and caudal fin, respectively. Molecular phylogenetic analysis further supports the validity of the species and reveals a close relationship with T. xuanweiensis .
papers.summary_cn: 描述了采自四川宜宾珙县长江上游地下支流的一种穴居盲条鳅属新种——Triplophysa boduensis，系四川省首次记录的洞穴条鳅属鱼类。该新种可通过无鳞无色素、眼退化（眼径为头长的4.3%–6.5%）、鳔后室发达、肠道短且无盘曲、下唇匙形等形态特征组合与其同属物种区分。分子系统发育分析支持其物种有效性，并显示其与T. xuanweiensis亲缘关系最近。

papers.title: Multiorgan histopathological assessment reveals gill-predominant changes in yellowtail (Seriola quinqueradiata) during acute exposure to the Chattonella marina complex
papers.authors: Hasegawa, Yuya; Mukai, Koki; Hotta, Takurou; Chujo, Taro; Yano, Ryoko; Hano, Takeshi; Takai, Yuki; Mochida, Kazuhiko; Nishimaki, Toshiyuki; Ogawa, Motoyuki
papers.abstract: Abstract Red tides caused by the raphidophyte Chattonella marina complex (hereafter Chattonella ) remain a threat to aquaculture despite current mitigation efforts. Although gill injury during Chattonella exposure has been reported, whether overt histopathological abnormalities occur in major extrabranchial organs during the acute preterminal phase remains unclear. We examined the physiological and histological responses of yellowtail ( Seriola quinqueradiata ) at 60 min after the start of acute Chattonella exposure. Physiological disturbance was first assessed based on blood partial oxygen pressure ( p O 2 ), plasma pH, and plasma Na + , K + , and Ca 2+ concentrations, followed by systematic histological examination of the gills, heart, liver, kidney, head kidney, spleen, intestine, and stomach, including organs reported to be affected by exposure to other harmful algae. Exposed fish showed decreased blood p O 2 , lower measured plasma pH, and increased measured plasma Na + , K + , and Ca 2+ concentrations. Under the present acute exposure conditions, overt hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-detectable abnormalities were gill-predominant and characterized by epithelial detachment at the base of the secondary lamellae, whereas no overt H&E-detectable abnormalities were identified in the other organs examined at this sampling point. These findings indicate a distinctive acute response profile to Chattonella exposure, characterized by altered blood parameters and gill-predominant histopathology without overt H&E-detectable abnormalities in the major extrabranchial organs examined.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了黄尾鰤（Seriola quinqueradiata）在急性暴露于Chattonella marina复合体60分钟后的生理与组织病理响应，测定了血液pO₂、血浆pH及Na⁺、K⁺、Ca²⁺浓度，并对鳃、心脏、肝、肾、头肾、脾、肠和胃进行系统组织学检查。暴露组出现血pO₂下降、血浆pH降低及Na⁺、K⁺、Ca²⁺升高，H&E可检测的明显异常以鳃为主，表现为次级鳃丝基部上皮脱落，而其他鳃外器官未见明显H&E可检测病变。结果表明，Chattonella急性暴露引发以血液参数改变和鳃为主的组织病理损伤为特征的响应模式，鳃外主要器官在此采样时间点未见明显异常。

papers.title: The guano dimension of seabird predation halos: colony size, foraging range and nutrient redistribution
papers.authors: Ezell, Eric Keen
papers.summary_cn: 研究探讨海鸟捕食光环中的鸟粪维度，关注群落规模、觅食范围与营养再分配之间的关系。

papers.title: Wintering-site overlap predicts mercury similarity in migratory seabirds

papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了迁徙海鸟在越冬地的重叠程度与其汞暴露相似性的关系。越冬地重叠可预测个体间汞负荷的相似性，提示越冬期摄食生态与污染物暴露存在关联。

papers.title: Quantification of fish bioturbation in tidal flats, Yatsushiro Sea, Japan, using unmanned aerial vehicle imaging and environmental DNA analysis
papers.authors: Hayashi, Risa; Inui, Ryutei; Nakao, Ryohei; Akamatsu, Yoshihisa; Ozaki, Tatsuya; Honda, Rikuto; Komorita, Tomohiro
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在量化日本八代海潮滩的鱼类生物扰动。方法结合无人机（UAV）成像与环境DNA（eDNA）分析，以评估鱼类活动对沉积物的扰动程度。

papers.title: Morphology of mangrove pneumatophores and Hormosira banksii determines the strength of facilitation cascades in Australian mangroves
papers.authors: van der Ouderaa, Isabelle Berthe Catharine; Eriksson, Britas Klemens; Van de Koppel, Johan; Bishop, Melanie
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨澳大利亚红树林中，红树气生根（pneumatophores）与褐藻 Hormosira banksii 的形态特征如何决定促进级联（facilitation cascades）的强度。基于标题推测，研究可能通过比较不同形态结构对相关生物群落的促进效应，揭示物理结构复杂性在驱动级联强度中的作用。

papers.summary_cn: 通过重复同位素特征分析，探讨长距离迁徙海鸟的冬季分布与觅食策略之间的关联。

papers.title: Predator–prey dynamics in nearshore rocky habitats of the Pribilof Islands, Alaska (USA), and potential impact on blue and red king crab recruitment
papers.authors: Weems, Jared David; Long, William; Eckert, Ginny L
papers.summary_cn: 本研究关注阿拉斯加Pribilof群岛近岸岩礁生境中的捕食者–猎物动态及其对蓝王蟹和红王蟹补充量的潜在影响，但摘要缺失，具体方法、结果与结论无法概括。

papers.title: Repeated marine-to-freshwater fish transitions reveal paleoenvironmental modulation of adaptive radiation
papers.authors: Medeiros, Aline P. M.; Rincon-Sandoval, Melissa; Davis, Aaron; Santaquiteria, Aintzane; Thacker, Christine E.; Egan, Joshua P.; Kim, Jonathan; Ko’ou, Alfred; Arcila, Dahiana; Ludt, William B.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: Tropical rivers in Australia and New Guinea (Sahul) provide a rare natural experiment in vertebrate evolution: Unlike other continental systems, their freshwater ichthyofaunas are composed almost entirely of marine-derived lineages rather than primary freshwater fishes. This unique biogeographic setting enables replicated tests of why some marine-to-freshwater transitions give rise to extensive adaptive radiations whereas others remain species-poor, and whether these outcomes reflect ecological opportunity or temporally structured paleoenvironmental constraints. Using a densely sampled, time-calibrated phylogenomic framework spanning 2,303 teleost species, we identified 27–34 marine-to-freshwater transitions during the Cenozoic, including a pronounced Middle Miocene peak (16–11 Ma). Although ecological opportunity in Sahul rivers enabled repeated colonization in the absence of dominant primary freshwater incumbents, younger freshwater lineages nevertheless diversify faster than older ones, contradicting the expectation that early arrivers should undergo elevated diversification when accessing vacant niche space. Although some colonizations coincide with bursts of speciation consistent with adaptive radiation, many yielded few species despite long residence times. Functional trait analyses likewise revealed no consistent relationship between colonization timing, ecological breadth, or lineage diversification rate, although expanded functional space characterizes previously proposed Sahul adaptive radiations. Comparisons with paleoenvironmental curves indicate that colonization success correlates with sea-level minima and low-oxygen conditions, suggesting that Earth history dynamics modulated when ecological opportunity was accessible. Our results show that although ecological opportunity enabled repeated freshwater invasions into the Sahul region, diversification outcomes are governed by the interaction of paleoenvironmental dynamics and possibly lineage-specific traits, generating stark asymmetries in freshwater radiations.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2303种真骨鱼类的系统发育基因组学框架，研究识别出新生代27–34次海洋至淡水过渡事件，并在中中新世（16–11 Ma）出现明显峰值。尽管Sahul地区河流的生态机会促成了反复定殖，但较年轻的淡水谱系多样化速率反而高于较早者，且定殖时间、生态幅与谱系多样化速率之间无一致关系。定殖成功与海平面低值及低氧条件相关，表明古环境动态调控了生态机会的可及性，进而导致淡水适应性辐射的显著不对称。

papers.title: Recurrent bycatch of immature green turtles by small-scale fisheries on the Amazon coast
papers.authors: de Oliveira, Tamires de A.P.; Santos, Ana Laura P.; San-Martin, Jéssica M.; Félix-Silva, Daniely; Figueiredo, Josie; Pezzuti, Juarez C.B.
papers.abstract: Knowledge of habitat use by immature stages of marine megafauna remains limited, particularly in regions with scarce records. Along the Amazon coast, the occurrence of immature Chelonia mydas has been documented only through isolated records, leaving unclear whether the species uses this region sporadically or as a regular habitat. This study aimed to investigate incidental captures of green turtles through five-year collaborative research with artisanal fishers in two Environmental Protection Areas in northern Brazil. Between 2017 and 2021, 153 individuals were recorded, the majority being juveniles and subadults. Captures occurred in both estuarine and marine habitats, with no significant differences in body size among years or between environments. Most captures were concentrated between March and July. Recapture data (n = 13) indicated short to moderate intervals between captures (median = 13 days; IQR: 10–150), suggesting repeated use of the area by some individuals. The consistent occurrence of immature turtles across multiple years and seasons indicates that the Amazon coast is not used only sporadically. Instead, the recurrent records indicate continuous use of the area and suggest that it may serve as a developmental or foraging habitat for C. mydas. These results provide novel baseline information for a poorly studied region and highlight the importance of Amazonian coastal ecosystems for the conservation of green turtles in the South Atlantic. Keywords: Chelonia mydas, Amazon estuary, mangroves, foraging ground
papers.summary_cn: 通过五年与巴西亚马逊海岸两个环境保护区内手工渔民的合作调查，记录了2017—2021年间153只绿海龟（Chelonia mydas）的兼捕事件，以幼体和亚成体为主，在河口与海洋生境中均有发生，主要集中在3—7月。重捕数据（n=13）显示个体间捕获间隔中位数为13天，表明部分个体对该区域存在重复利用。研究表明亚马逊海岸并非绿海龟幼体的偶见栖息地，而是其持续的发育或觅食场所，为这一数据匮乏区域的绿海龟保护提供了重要基线信息。

papers.title: Genomic evidence for facultative selfing in the cichlid fish Cyphotilapia frontosa
papers.authors: Uysal, M Efe; Souza-Costa, Daniela; Marks, Allison; Indermaur, Adrian; Gessl, Wolfgang; Salzburger, Walter; Barth, Julia M I
papers.abstract: Abstract Organisms have evolved a remarkable diversity of reproductive strategies in response to environmental variations and selective pressures. Although most vertebrates do reproduce biparentally, rare alternative modes such as selfing (self-fertilization) and different forms of parthenogenesis exist, but remain poorly characterized. Here, we investigated an unusual reproductive event in the normally biparental cichlid fish Cyphotilapia frontosa, in which a female produced offspring in the absence of a male. Using whole-genome sequencing data, we analyzed whether reproduction occurred via selfing or parthenogenesis by comparing patterns of heterozygosity with those from a wild, genetically diverse C. frontosa family collected in Lake Tanganyika and a closely related inbred Ctenochromis benthicola family. The uniparental family exhibited reduced genetic diversity, elevated relatedness, and genome-wide patterns of homozygosity distinct from those expected under parthenogenesis or inbreeding, but consistent with self-fertilization. Our study provides rare genomic evidence of selfing in a vertebrate and suggests that such alternative reproductive modes may be overlooked rather than truly absent. These findings contribute to a broader understanding of how alternative reproductive strategies evolve in vertebrate lineages.
papers.summary_cn: 对通常行两性生殖的慈鲷科鱼类 *Cyphotilapia frontosa* 中一例雌鱼在无雄鱼条件下产仔的异常生殖事件进行了基因组学分析。通过全基因组测序，将单亲家系的杂合度模式与坦噶尼喀湖野生遗传多样性家系及近交的 *Ctenochromis benthicola* 家系比较，发现该单亲家系遗传多样性降低、亲缘度升高，其全基因组纯合模式区别于 parthenogenesis 或近交预期，而与 self-fertilization 一致。研究提供了脊椎动物中罕见的 selfing 基因组证据，提示此类替代生殖模式可能被忽视而非真正缺失。

2026-W42.topic: 水产养殖可持续发展与鱼类健康生态研究
2026-W42.keywords: 水产养殖(Aquaculture), 鱼类免疫(Fish Immunity), 种群遗传(Population Genetics), 渔业经济(Fisheries Economics), 抗菌活性(Antibacterial Activity), 鱼类寄生虫(Fish Parasites), 栖息地连通性(Habitat Connectivity), 污染物暴露(Pollutant Exposure)
2026-W42.article:
## 本周研究概览

本周共收录4篇渔业相关论文，全部发表于 *Journal of Fish Biology*，研究方向涵盖分子生态学方法、物种杂交与保护遗传学、气候变化下的鱼类分布变动以及水产养殖免疫机制。整体来看，本周研究呈现出两个鲜明特征：一是方法学导向的研究（如DNA保存方案优化）为后续生态-遗传数据整合提供技术支撑；二是应用导向的研究（如杂交监测、北极鳕鱼分布扩展、细菌感染免疫应答）直接回应保护管理与养殖生产的现实需求。值得注意的是，多篇论文均涉及人为活动（如气候变暖、栖息地改造）对鱼类种群的影响，反映出当前渔业科学对全球变化背景下种群响应机制的高度关注。

## 高影响力期刊亮点

本周暂无发表于 Nature、Science、PNAS、Nature Climate Change、Nature Ecology & Evolution、Nature Sustainability、Nature Communications、Science Advances 等高影响力期刊的渔业相关论文。

## 创新性研究

1. **Active nuclease inhibition over passive freezing secures the genomic archive of fish eye lenses**（*Journal of Fish Biology*）
   该研究的创新点在于系统比较了主动核酸酶抑制与被动冷冻两种策略对鱼眼晶状体基因组DNA保存效果的影响，并首次为这一兼具生态与遗传信息价值的组织提出了标准化保存方案。鱼眼晶状体可提供个体生活史的时间序列档案，但死后核酸酶降解长期制约着生态与遗传数据的整合。该方法的建立有望推动鱼类个体水平“生态-基因组”联合研究在野外和博物馆样本中的广泛应用。

2. **Widespread hybridization in sympatric populations of allis shad *Alosa alosa* and twaite shad *Alosa fallax*: A transnational perspective for conservation and management**（*Journal of Fish Biology*）
   该研究以跨国尺度揭示了同域分布的西鲱（allis shad）与芬塔西鲱（twaite shad）之间存在广泛的杂交现象，创新性地将杂交格局与人为环境改造联系起来。研究结果对两种鲱鱼的保护单元界定和渔业管理策略提出了直接挑战，提示在制定保护措施时需充分考虑杂交对遗传完整性的潜在侵蚀。

3. **Seasonal presence, movements and behaviour of Atlantic cod (*Gadus morhua*) in Isfjorden, Svalbard**（*Journal of Fish Biology*）
   该研究聚焦北极化（Atlantification）背景下大西洋鳕鱼向斯瓦尔巴群岛峡湾的北向扩张，通过监测其季节性出现、移动和行为模式，提供了 boreal 物种入侵北极生态系统的直接行为学证据。其创新之处在于将气候变化驱动的海洋环境变动与鱼类个体行为响应相衔接，为预测北极渔业资源重组提供了关键基线数据。

4. **Transcriptomic analysis reveals the immune response mechanisms of *Acrossocheilus fasciatus* against *Citrobacter freundii* infection**（*Journal of Fish Biology*）
   该研究结合组织学观察与RNA-seq技术，系统解析了光唇鱼（*Acrossocheilus fasciatus*）肠道和脾脏对弗氏柠檬酸杆菌感染的免疫应答机制。其创新点在于首次为该经济鱼种提供了细菌感染的转录组水平免疫图谱，为水产养殖中该病的防控和抗病育种提供了候选基因资源。

## 推荐阅读

1. **Active nuclease inhibition over passive freezing secures the genomic archive of fish eye lenses** — 为鱼眼晶状体这一特殊组织的DNA保存提供了首个标准化方案，方法学价值突出，值得从事生态-遗传整合研究的学者关注。
2. **Widespread hybridization in sympatric populations of allis shad *Alosa alosa* and twaite shad *Alosa fallax*: A transnational perspective for conservation and management** — 跨国尺度的杂交监测为鲱鱼保护管理敲响警钟，对保护遗传学和管理实践均有重要参考意义。
3. **Seasonal presence, movements and behaviour of Atlantic cod (*Gadus morhua*) in Isfjorden, Svalbard** — 提供了北极化背景下鳕鱼北扩的行为学证据，是气候变化与渔业资源变动交叉领域的重要案例。
4. **Transcriptomic analysis reveals the immune response mechanisms of *Acrossocheilus fasciatus* against *Citrobacter freundii* infection** — 为水产养殖中细菌性疾病防控提供了转录组水平的机制解析和候选基因资源。
5. **Widespread hybridization in sympatric populations of allis shad *Alosa alosa* and twaite shad *Alosa fallax*: A transnational perspective for conservation and management** — 再次推荐，因其跨国合作框架和明确的保护管理指向，对区域渔业管理具有直接政策意义。

2026-W41.topic: 渔业研究多维拓展：气候、生态与社会融合
2026-W41.keywords: 休闲渔业(Recreational Fisheries), 气候变化(Climate Change), 渔业管理(Fisheries Management), 水产养殖(Aquaculture), 微塑料污染(Microplastic Contamination), 鱼类栖息地(Fish Habitat), 入侵物种(Invasive Species), 可持续渔业(Sustainable Fisheries)
2026-W41.article:
## 本周研究概览

本周共收录5篇渔业相关论文，研究方向较为分散，涵盖渔业技术现代化、鱼类行为分析、渔业考古、替代蛋白源开发以及鱼类微生物组学。整体来看，本周论文呈现出明显的跨学科特征：一方面，自动化、电子监控（electronic monitoring, EM）与人工智能（AI）在捕捞业中的应用受到持续关注；另一方面，鱼类健康与饲料可持续性问题仍是水产养殖领域的核心议题。值得注意的是，本周缺乏发表在顶级综合性期刊上的高影响力成果，研究更多集中于专业领域期刊，反映出渔业科学本周以应用导向和方法创新为主。

## 高影响力期刊亮点

本周暂无。

## 创新性研究

1. **From Mechanized Longlines to Smart Fisheries: Integrating Automation, Electronic Monitoring, and Artificial Intelligence**（Journal of Marine Science and Engineering）
   该综述系统整合了71篇文献，梳理了延绳钓渔业从机械化到智能化的技术演进路径，重点讨论了自动化、EM与AI的协同整合。其创新之处在于将分散的技术进展纳入统一框架，为智能渔业（smart fisheries）的落地提供了系统性参考，对渔业管理与合规监测具有潜在政策意义。

2. **Fish 3D Clustering App (F3DCA): A Non-Supervised Clustering Method with a Machine Learning Autoencoder for Analyzing 3D Trajectories of Three Fish Species**（Biology）
   该研究开发了一种基于无监督学习与自编码器（autoencoder）的3D轨迹聚类工具，用于分析三种鱼类的运动行为。其创新点在于将深度学习降维与聚类相结合，减少了对人工标注的依赖，为鱼类行为表型分析及神经退行性过程研究提供了可推广的方法学工具。

3. **Bacterial Taxonomic Profiling of Freshwater Fish Across Hydrographic Basins of Kazakhstan**（Fishes）
   该研究对哈萨克斯坦六大水文盆地、六个科的193尾野生淡水鱼进行了多组织（鳃、肾、脾、肝）细菌群落测序分析，填补了中亚地区鱼类微生物组数据的空白。其创新性在于大空间尺度的跨流域采样设计，为理解环境与宿主因素对鱼类微生物群落的影响提供了基础数据。

4. **Production of African House Fly (Musca Domestica) Maggots using Decomposed Wastes, Cow Dung and Sawdust as a Sustainable Protein Source for Poultry, Fish and Pig Feeds**（International Journal For Multidisciplinary Research）
   该研究探索了利用分解废弃物、牛粪和锯末培养家蝇（Musca domestica）幼虫作为替代蛋白源的可行性，以应对乌干达鱼粉和大豆粕成本上升的问题。其创新点在于将废弃物管理与饲料生产相结合，具有循环经济与可持续水产养殖的双重意义，但研究深度与规模化验证仍需加强。

## 推荐阅读

1. **From Mechanized Longlines to Smart Fisheries: Integrating Automation, Electronic Monitoring, and Artificial Intelligence** — 系统性强，是了解智能渔业技术整合路径的重要综述。
2. **Fish 3D Clustering App (F3DCA): A Non-Supervised Clustering Method with a Machine Learning Autoencoder for Analyzing 3D Trajectories of Three Fish Species** — 方法学创新突出，工具具有可复用性。
3. **Bacterial Taxonomic Profiling of Freshwater Fish Across Hydrographic Basins of Kazakhstan** — 区域数据稀缺性强，采样设计扎实。
4. **Production of African House Fly (Musca Domestica) Maggots using Decomposed Wastes, Cow Dung and Sawdust as a Sustainable Protein Source for Poultry, Fish and Pig Feeds** — 面向实际问题的替代蛋白探索，具有应用潜力。
5. **An Early Neolithic Burial with a Miniature Fish-Shaped Bait on the Shore of Lake Baikal** — 视角独特，为渔业活动的早期考古证据提供了新素材。

## 本周研究概览

本周共收录渔业相关论文10篇，研究方向涵盖水产养殖营养与饲料替代、鱼类寄生虫分类学、鱼类生殖生物学与种群遗传学、渔业可持续性评估、鱼类病毒性疾病防控以及微藻水处理技术等多个领域。整体来看，水产养殖的可持续发展是本周的核心议题，多篇论文围绕饲料替代、天然活性物质应用和水质净化展开研究。与此同时，分类学与生态学基础研究亦有新发现，包括泰国淡水鱼类寄生虫新种和台湾吻虾虎鱼隐存种的描述。研究方法上，稳定同位素分析、中性粒模糊评价框架等新方法的应用值得关注。

## 高影响力期刊亮点

本周暂无发表在Nature、Science、PNAS等上述高影响力期刊上的渔业相关论文。

## 创新性研究

1. **β-myrcene: A nature-identical compound for sustainable aquaculture**（Journal of the World Aquaculture Society）
该研究提出β-月桂烯（β-myrcene）作为一种天然等同化合物在水产养殖中的可持续应用潜力。其创新之处在于将植物源天然化合物系统引入水产养殖的病害防控与生长促进领域，为减少化学药物依赖提供了新思路，对推动绿色水产养殖具有潜在影响。

2. **Assessing the Sustainability Performance of Fishing Harbors Under Uncertainty: A Gaussian-Neutrosophic Framework**（Sustainable Development）
该研究首次将高斯中性模糊集（Gaussian-Neutrosophic）框架引入渔港可持续性评估，有效处理了评价过程中的不确定性问题。其方法论创新为渔业基础设施的可持续管理提供了更稳健的决策工具，有望推广至其他渔业管理场景。

3. **A new cryptic species of Rhinogobius from northern Taiwan**（Journal of Fish Biology）
该研究描述了采自台湾翡翠水库的吻虾虎鱼隐存种——*Rhinogobius feitsuiensis* sp. nov.，并对*R. similis*种复合体内的隐存多样性进行了讨论。隐存种的发现提示该物种复合体的多样性可能被严重低估，对台湾及东亚淡水鱼类生物多样性保护与分类学修订具有重要意义。

4. **Antiviral activity of chlorogenic acid against largemouth bass virus**（Journal of Fish Biology）
该研究首次系统评估了绿原酸（chlorogenic acid, CGA）对大口黑鲈病毒（LMBV）的体内外抗病毒活性。将天然多酚化合物应用于鱼类病毒病防控，为水产养殖中抗病毒药物的开发提供了候选分子，也为替代传统化学抗病毒策略开辟了新路径。

5. **Identification of Microalgae, Evaluation of Water Purification Efficiency, and Optimization of Large-Scale Production Conditions Based on RAS**（Plants）
该研究筛选了四种微藻对循环水养殖系统（RAS）废水中氨氮和亚硝态氮的去除能力，并优化了大规模生产条件。其创新在于将微藻水处理与RAS实际工况相结合，为养殖尾水的生物净化提供了可规模化实施的方案。

## 推荐阅读

1. **Antiviral activity of chlorogenic acid against largemouth bass virus (*Micropterus salmoides*) in vitro and in vivo** — 天然化合物抗鱼类病毒的新尝试，体内外实验结合，具有较强的应用转化潜力。
2. **A new cryptic species of *Rhinogobius* from northern Taiwan, with remarks on the cryptic diversity within the *Rhinogobius similis* species complex** — 隐存种描述对东亚淡水鱼类分类学与保护生物学具有重要参考价值。
3. **Assessing the Sustainability Performance of Fishing Harbors Under Uncertainty: A Gaussian-Neutrosophic Framework** — 方法论创新突出，为渔业可持续性评估提供了处理不确定性的新工具。
4. **Ontogenetic and spatial variation in the trophic ecology of the shortfin mako shark (*Isurus oxyrinchus*) in temperate eastern Australia** — 对全球关注度高的濒危鲨鱼物种进行营养生态学分析，数据稀缺区域的研究填补了知识空白。
5. **β-myrcene: A nature-identical compound for sustainable aquaculture** — 选题契合水产养殖绿色转型趋势，天然等同化合物的应用前景值得关注。
